notes.title: Caliber: Expanding Horizons
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/dd4d6a96cb37f7cf3e0407bcddfd35b8c0e6422b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our game has officially received an approval from the National Press and Publication Administration of China (NPPA). It means that in 2026, [i]Caliber[/i] will be officially released in China. At the end of 2025, an open beta testing will start. The OBT will be available only for local players: there will be a separate game client, fully compatible with the specifics and rules of the Chinese market.[/p][p]This release could not be possible without our partner War Flames, one of the leading online game publishers in PRC.[/p][p]It is an important stage of the game’s development: [i]Caliber[/i] continues to unite players from all over the world![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.0: New Mythic Outfit, Mode and Fixes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/17d0d0a77a61d3ad48897906acf99f51aaf682d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hotfix 1.2.0: Available Now![/p][p]A new Simargl Mythic Outfit for Assault Volk from the Vympel unit was added to Caliber. The outfit bundle includes thematic items such as an Execution, a Reprisal, an HQ Background, etc.[/p][p]Besides, this update features some important changes: known bugs that had been crashing the game were fixed, Faust’s primary weapon was buffed, a priority to Medics was set in the Onslaught: Reinforcement mode battle search, and some other technical issues were fixed. [/p][p]See full list of changes is below.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]SIMARGL MYTHIC OUTFIT[/b][/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="KXJQXpyEk_0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Introducing a new Simargl Mythic Outfit for Assault Volk from the Vympel unit![/p][p]The outfit’s silhouette reminds of a wolf with wings—a fast and dangerous creature. The outfit changes operator’s appearance, his equipment, and a number of animations: from reloading to ability activation.[/p][p]Shots from both primary and secondary weapons are followed by unique tracers and shells. Additionally, the primary weapon stands out with exclusive shot flares.[/p][p]The Simargl bundle includes the Outfit itself, as well as exclusive thematic items: an Execution, a Reprisal, an HQ Background, and other.[/p][h3]
[url="https://playcaliber.com/en/store/skins/Simargl/"][b]Simargl[/b][/url][/h3][p][/p][h2][b]ASSAULT FAUST[/b][/h2][list][*][p]SIG553 primary weapon:[/p][/*][*][p]Body shot damage increase: it is now 20 instead of 19.[/p][/*][*][p]Headshot damage increase: it is now 33 instead of 30.[/p][/*][*][p]Armor penetration increase: it is now 55% instead of 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage points were corrected on all distances.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]OTHER CHANGES[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Showdown: 8x8 mode was added to the Weekend mode category. During the Reinforcement event, you will get Tokens as a reward for victory in this mode. [/p][/*][*][p]Team Deathmatch mode migrated from the Weekend mode category to the PvP category.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the Gas effect to inflict damage immediately instead of after the intended one-second delay.[/p][/*][*][p]Immunity to the Gas effect no longer protects from slowing down.[/p][/*][*][p]Onslaught: Reinforcement: added a priority to the Medic role during battle search. If a player selects all roles, the matchmaker will give preference to the Medic role.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]FIXES[/b][/h2][list][*][p]A number of known issues that caused the game/battle to crash were fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Team Deathmatch mode: fixed a bug that allowed players to choose two same operators for one team.[/p][/*][*][p]Point Sweep and Special Operation modes: fixed a bug that prevented sergeant bots from deploying drones.[/p][/*][*][p]Radar map, Team Deathmatch mode: fixed a bug that caused a point capture to count even if a player was outside the area.[/p][/*][*][p]Support Prorok: fixed a bug that prevented the ability marker from disappearing after using the ability.[/p][/*][*][p]G95 weapon: fixed a bug that caused an incorrect weapon camo to be displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused a Back into the Fray container to display in the Defender of the Fatherland container section. Old unopened containers will remain in this category while all new ones will appear in the correct category.[/p][/*][*][p]Onslaught: Reinforcement: fixed a bug that caused incorrect player icons to display and the game to freeze.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Attention: important news about update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/0ea5c46bbfa40198626cc9ffdb6d8cb02eb219af.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Two important pieces of news we’d like to share with you![/p][p]After installing update 1.2.0, please be sure to check the Special Offers tab in the game client—a nice reward is waiting for you there. Hurry up to collect it until September 21.[/p][p]In the Onslaught: Reinforcement mode, we’ve removed a requirement for the second Medic. This is a temporary solution to make the matchmaking easier and faster during the first week of the update’s release.[/p][p]Next week, there will be prioritized matchmaking: if the fireteam has all roles, the system will prefer the second Medic to other roles. However, this won’t become a strict rule.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0: Available Now!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/759353d3f6e28375f8e292b460f72a61ec8a9ae3.jpg"][/img]A new 1.2.0 version is here. The game servers are open![/p][p]What’s new: a new Storm Squad Battle Pass with a German operator Faust from the SEK unit, a Reinforcement event with new 8x8 PvP mode and PvE mode for 6 players, as well as Reward Log with rewards for daily logins and more.[/p][p] [/p][p]You can find the full list of changes below.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/h2][h3][b]CONTENT AND EVENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added the new Storm Squad Battle Pass with a new Assault from the SEK collection.[/p][/*][*][p]Reinforcement event started. Added Team Deathmatch PvP mode (8x8), Onslaught: Reinforcement PvE mode (for 6 players), and unique event rewards. [/p][/*][*][p]Added Reward Log—gain rewards for logging into the game every day.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced weapon customization: more than 60 guns received suppressors. They are available in Weapon and Elite Weapon Containers.[/p][/*][*][p]Back into the Fray Event started.[/p][p][u][b]IT’S TIME TO RETURN INTO THE BATTLE![/b][/u][/p][p]If you haven’t been to Caliber for a long time, you can return nice and easy, especially with lots of gifts that are waiting for you in the game.[/p][list][*][p]If you haven’t entered Caliber for more than 2 months: until October 1, you can claim a free bundle with valuable items in the Special Offers section. [/p][/*][*][p]If you haven’t entered Caliber for more than 1 month: there will be a special Back on Duty tab in the Reward Log. Log in every day and receive a gift.[/p][/*][*][p]If you haven’t entered Caliber for more than 21 days: during Back into the Fray event, play in one fireteam with active players and gain rewards.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]RANKED BATTLES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The number of operator bans increased up to six: three bans for each team. Voting time is now 6 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Loss of points for the most effective player in the battle returned.[/p][p][b][u]This is how it works:[/u][/b][/p][p]If you end up being the most effective player of the match among both teams, but your team loses the match, then you will lose 80% Rank Points less.[/p][p]Effectiveness is determined by the number of Ribbons acquired:[/p][list][*][p]Medical Specialist.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage Specialist.[/p][/*][*][p]Elimination Specialist.[/p][/*][*][p]Utility Specialist.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]FIXES[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that allowed the objective drone to move without players’ escort.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented players from purchasing Camos in the operator’s settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]MSBS GROT C16 FB-M1: fixed the weapon model, an extra detail was removed.[/p][/*][*][p]M4A1: fixed a bug that caused a projectile to clip through the grenade launcher model.[/p][/*][*][p]Frontline HQ Background: fixed a bug that cut the lower part of the Background.[/p][/*][*][p]Videnskaben HQ Background: fixed an incorrect display of the car’s side windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Support, Medic, and Marksman Prologue mode: fixed a bug that caused “Prologue: Assault” text to appear on the loading screen.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]OPERATORS[/b][/h2][h3]CST[/h3][h3]Assault Sly[/h3][list][*][p]Impersonation Ability: fixed a bug that caused Sly’s maximum HP to remain as her copied target’s maximum HP after the ability ended. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]NESHER[/h3][h3]Medic Shersheret[/h3][list][*][p]Lamia Legendary Outfit: fixed an incorrect texture display on some equipment elements.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Marksman Eima[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an incorrect primary weapon shot animation.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]MAPS AND MISSIONS[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Special Operation and Onslaught: Legend modes: fixed a bug that made bots too weak. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]PALM ROAD[/h3][h3]PvE Version [/h3][list][*][p]Point Sweep and Special Operation modes: fixed incorrect positions of some environment objects.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]HOSPITAL[/h3][h3]PvE Version [/h3][list][*][p]Point Sweep and Special Operation modes: fixed a bug that caused a bot to appear without a car.[/p][/*][*][p]Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that made it impossible to climb one of the elevations.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]AL-MALIK HOTEL[/h3][list][*][p]All modes: fixed a gap between textures of one of the buildings.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]RADAR[/h3][h3]PvPvE Version [/h3][list][*][p]Threshold mode: fixed a bug that made it possible to enter the non-playable area.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]POLAR STATION[/h3][h3]PvE Version [/h3][list][*][p]Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that caused operators to stand knee-deep in snow during the final cutscene.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]SPACEPORT[/h3][list][*][p]Threshold mode: fixed a bug that caused an redundant object to appear in the air near the handrails.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]SOUND[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Karkhad Theater of War, all modes: added new music to the loading screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Music volume decreased on the login screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added suppressor sounds for weapons that received this module in this update.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Version 1.1.2 is available now!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/52de6e83d282d5cbebe618457c92880b70bcec63.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Maintenance is over, the game is available![/h3][p] [/p][p]Version 1.1.2 has been installed. In this update, you'll find not only the new Battle Pass, Ranked Season, and new content but also operator and weapon rebalance, along with fixes for known issues.[/p][p] [/p][p]Read the full patch note below.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]CONTENT AND EVENTS[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added the Toxin Queen Battle Pass with Legendary Outfits for Nesher.[/p][/*][*][p]Hellish Heat Ranked Season started.[/p][/*][*][p]Clan Season 5 started.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to change the appearance of the SR-3 and AKS-74U.[/p][/*][*][p]Containers: added a counter for the remaining items inside the Container. [/p][/*][*][p]Army Surplus Containers and Veteran Containers: now, when you receive a Legendary Outfit, a system message will be displayed in the HQ.[/p][/*][*][p]May 9th 2020 HQ Background: it is now of Rare quality. [/p][/*][*][p]Army Surplus Container: the container tab now displays secret Legendary Outfits (they are now also displayed on the operator tabs!).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]FIXES[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Great Strategist Steam achievement: fixed a bug when the achievement for completing weekly objectives wasn’t counted.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization: loading into battles accelerated for players with low-powered PCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Clans: fixed a bug that caused data to display incorrectly in Clan Season leaderboards. Previously, the leaderboards showed incorrect numbers, which caused confusion—it looked like rewards were awarded only for the results of the All Players table, and not for all three. In fact, the Clan Season system has always counted the results of all three tables and correctly awarded the rewards based on the overall performance of a clan. Now, we have fixed the visual bug and the tables are fully consistent with the actual calculations, which will prevent confusion and give an accurate picture of each clan's achievements.[/p][/*][*][p]Clans: fixed a bug that caused invalid information to display in the “Best place in leaderboards” and “Last season” rows.[/p][/*][*][p]Notification window: fixed a bug that caused technical text and incorrect pictures to display in the window.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons tab: fixed a bug that prevented the camera from moving to the muzzle when selecting the corresponding modules.[/p][/*][*][p]Oil Platform and Hospital missions: fixed some small visual bugs in the final cutscene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the effect with the lower value to apply when two speed boost effects were applied to an operator.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Container: fixed a bug that made it possible to receive a module for a weapon that wasn’t on the account.[/p][/*][*][p]Hagana’s turret, Shàowèi’s and Tirkesh’s drones: fixed a bug that prevented damage dealing to enemies from being counted.[/p][/*][*][p]Nesher: fixed some small typos in operators’ upgrades description.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]OPERATORS[/b][/h2][h3][b]VYMPEL[/b][/h3][h3]Support Almaz[/h3][list][*][p]Aegis ability: base Shielded is now 60 instead of 65.[/p][/*][*][p]Aegis ability: fixed a bug that prevented Shielded from restoring and the ability from recharging if the operator was attacked by Corsair with the Black Mark ability active.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade #5-1 “Increases durability of the shield created by the ability”: is now 20 instead of 25.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade #9-2 “Increases durability of the shield created by the ability”: is now 20 instead of 25.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]SSO[/b][/h3][h3]Medic Bard[/h3][list][*][p]Upgrade #14-1: fixed a bug that caused the ability to recharge instantly after executing an enemy instead of reducing the cooldown by 3 seconds as stated in the description.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Marksman Komar[/h3][list][*][p]Onslaught and Onslaught: Legend modes: fixed a bug that caused the game to crash.  It occurred New Sharp Eye Battle Pass as well as Back Into The Fray Referral Program awaits you.[/p][p]Additionally, we've worked on the karma system and fixed numerous known bugs.[/p][p]Check out the full list of changes below.[/p][p][/p][h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1][p][/p][h3]Content and events:[/h3][list][*][p]Added the Sharp Eye Battle Pass with new weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Sharp Eye Battle Pass with new weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Улучшено оповещение о получении ежедневной награды боевого пропуска за приобретённые эпизоды.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved a notification for receiving a daily Battle Pass reward for purchased Episodes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a weapon rotating animation in the Battle Pass tab.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Karma[/h2][p]Karma penalty system changes:[/p][list][*][p]Leaving a battle — minus 25 Points.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaving a Ranked battle — minus 25 Points[/p][/*][*][p]Leaving from the operator selection screen — minus 10 Points.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaving a Ranked battle from the operator selection screen — minus 10 Points.[/p][/*][*][p]If you haven’t received any Karma Points for 5 days — minus 1,000 Points.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Karma system: removed an empty line when viewing another player’s profile.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the commendation button for a reported player to display incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Ranked Battles: fixed an operator selection bug in a loaded battle. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused tips and preliminary team results to appear and overlap the settings when pressing the TAB, F1, or F3 buttons in the Settings tab during a battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused customized weapons to display incorrectly in the Outfits that were not purchased.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the game to work incorrectly because of a large number of clan notifications.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused a corresponding weapon icon to display incorrectly when a Legendary Outfit was applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an incorrect display of Credits and Fragments when previewing rewards of the Victorious March Container on the Common Cause page.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons: fixed a bug that caused sights to display incorrectly when selecting an outfit without applying.[/p][/*][*][p]Skills: fixed a reactivation of skills that should trigger once per round.[/p][/*][*][p]The Sort icon now works correctly and doesn’t overlap the text when selecting any option in the pop-up window.[/p][/*][*][p]Training, Threshold Mode: removed the progress for completing daily and weekly objectives in battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the "Always display the HP bar above allied players" setting in replays and the Spectator mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused HK21 (KULSPRUTA 58 in the Woodward Legendary Outfit) to display incorrectly during reloading.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]OPERATORS[/h1][p][/p][h3][b]Travnik, ALPHA[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Scarecrow Epic Outfit: fixed an incorrect sight color.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the legendary weapon module to display incorrectly if the operator wasn’t purchased.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Sputnik, SSO[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Archeologist and Wanderer Legendary Outfits: the survival light on the helmet now has the correct color (red).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an incorrect position of the weapon from the Archeologist Legendary Outfit when applying the Anticyclone Legendary Outfit to an operator.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Komar, SSO[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the shoulder to be visible in the crosshairs when reloading.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the operator in the Anticyclone Legendary Outfit to display in the air in the HQ.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Scout, SEAL[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an incorrect position of the SIG 550 weapon.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bones, CST[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an incorrect stand with HK53 (AK 5D in the Woodward notes.title: Expanded Customization of the AKS-74U
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/c655bcf9662cbd5a2c05cae9de4d86635e0dd513.jpg"][/img]One of the main rewards of the Sharp Eye Battle Pass is the AKS-74U with updated functionality featuring an expanded list of modules. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Get the full access at once:[/b] purchase the Battle Pass and get all the modules. [/p][p][b]More module types:[/b] for example, pistol grips that are completely new.[/p][p][b]Flexible balance:[/b] in order to maintain the game balance and variety, some modules provide not only benefits but disadvantages too.[/p][p][/p][p]Currently, the construction set will be available only for Travnik, Shersheret, Yàowáng, and Bones, but we plan to continue further weapon customization development. [/p][p][/p][h3]The list of additional modules for the new version of AKS-74U:
[/h3][p][b]Sights:[/b][/p][p]• Cobra[/p][p]• PK-AS  [/p][p]• 1P63  [/p][p]• 1P87[/p][p]• 1P87 + 1P90[/p][p]• Populist[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Muzzle equipment:[/b][/p][p]• Hexagon DTKP  [/p][p]• Hexagon DTKP2  [/p][p]• PBS-4  [/p][p]• Bolgarin flash suppressor  [/p][p]• Zenit-1 breach muzzle brake  [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Laser Designators:[/b][/p][p]• Zenit Perst Classic (laser color—blue)[/p][p]• PP-93 laser designator (laser color—green)[/p][p]• Zenit 2PS + laser designator (laser color—red)[/p][p]  [/p][p][b]Stock:[/b][/p][p]• MVRI 04.22.000 telescopic stock  [/p][p]• AK-74M stock + AK/AKM butt plate (Kalosha)  [/p][p]• AKM stock (veneer)  [/p][p]• RPK-203 stock  [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Grips:[/b][/p][p]• Zenit RK-1  [/p][p]• Zenit RK-6  [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Pistol grips:[/b][/p][p]• AK-12  [/p][p]• AK-74M  [/p][p]• AK-74  [/p][p]• АК-74 mod2[/p][p]• Zenit RK-3  [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Magazines:[/b][/p][p]• 20-round magazine (armor-piercing rounds) [/p][p]• 30-round magazine (increased limb damage)[/p][p]• 45-round magazine[/p][p]• 45-round low-velocity magazine (subsonic rounds)[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Chapter II: Enemy's Counterattack Has Been Broken Up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/d62870471ec11e4f49ddd306f72e8c2991624370.jpg[/img]
Soldiers! Your teamwork, determination, and professionalism brought us victory one more time! During fierce battles, you not only fought the enemy's onslaught back, but also completed the key operation stage earlier than expected. Thanks to your efforts, the strategic initiative remains in our hands. Now you can claim your rewards for the stage completion.

Also, new positive modifiers were activated in the Storm mode: use them to strengthen your positions.

The Supply Center highly appreciated your actions and provided an additional motivation: [b]5VQWK56V[/b].

The next stage—Liberation—begins on May 28. We also recommend focusing on your Personal Impact and preparing for a decisive offensive.
 
Your valor will be rewarded. To the new victories!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/b121591e879bd69a539d3bba3073c40e62c6ab9a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/0c375f9578c06d3b370c8968b152113ec170bbf1.jpg[/img]
While shields are filling the news feeds, it's time to remember what it means to hold the fort for real. Shield is not cowardice but confidence. Tibet does not retreat: he faces his enemy like a titan… with a titan shield.

From May 16 to May 19, the Tibet Bundle is available with a 30% discount.

If you respect shields as much as gun power, Tibet will be waiting for you: 
https://playcaliber.com/en/store/specials/Tibet-Set-Karakurt/

notes.title: Chapter II: Counterattack!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/705818aa1dbbb796566d0e5019f66f3824d34652.jpg[/img]
Soldiers, a new stage of confrontation begins. It’s time to counterattack the enemy!

From May 14 to May 28, venture into battles, assault the enemy bunker, send operators to complete objectives, and don’t forget to call for reinforcements in order to earn more Combat Merits and get rewards.

To Victory!

notes.title: Happy Victory Day

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/709c7b12b578aa081e2b430dac9e850750fb1208.jpg[/img]

But for all of us, it’s memory of people who did the impossible for our future.
All we want to say is that we remember and we are thankful.

[*] Hunting Grounds, Eastern Highway, and Bridge HQ Backgrounds: fixed a bug that prevented gamma and brightness settings from saving.
[*] M240LWS procured weapon: fixed incorrect poses in the HQ for Almaz, Svarog, Sputnik, and Kit.

notes.title: Special Operation: Something Happened To Bots…
notes.content:
Warning, fighters!

A recon unit from the Special Operation mode reports the following: after today's update, enemy bots have become weaker! They deal less damage and have fewer HP: this has been noticed on all maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/1fde0adb824b43088ed2c5f60fe91311029b2fb8.jpg[/img]

P.S. Recon soldiers have also found weird symbols (BPJ1ZDGY) on the scene with a note “300 activations only, let the fastest win.”

notes.title: Update 1.0.2: patch note
notes.content:
The maintenance is over, and the game is available again!

We have fixed a number of issues, including the incorrect work of the Suppressed effect, a constant radio effect in operators' voice lines, and excessively loud sound in the voice chat.

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Operators screen: fixed a bug which prevented parameters on the panel from updating when upgrades that increase magazine or cartridge number were chosen.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused an incorrect Camo to appear on an unpurchased weapon in Practice mode.
[*] Onslaught mode window: updated mode description (old objectives were deleted).
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the (TAB), (C), and (ESC) tabs from opening during a surrender voting.
[*] Replays, PvE modes: fixed a bug that caused a message “Victory! Team B” to appear for a spectator in case of a defeat.
[*]  Threshold: Training Mission: fixed a bug which allowed returning into the battle after leaving it using the “Leave battle” button.
[*] Onslaught, Point Sweep, and Special Operation modes: fixed a bug that caused an operator portrait to cover the ally microphone mute button during loading.
[*] Headquarters HQ background: fixed an incorrect applying of the Color Correction setting.
[*] In-game store: fixed the order of displaying operators in the customization item purchasing window: now it corresponds to the Operators tab.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the “Operator Test” button active while in a fireteam.
[*] HQ chat: fixed a bug that prevented an @all command tip for fireteam members from showing.
[*] HQ chat: fixed a bug that caused read messages to appear again after leaving a battle.
[*] Kill log: fixed a bug that prevented the emblem of the enemy who killed you from displaying.
[*] Clans: fixed a bug that prevented an underscore symbol from being used in the clan search bar.
[*] Operator settings tab: fixed a bug that caused the “Hide UI” tip to cover skill slots.
[*] Combat hint (F1) window: fixed a bug that caused incorrect data to appear.
[*] Incapacitated state: fixed a bug that caused a visual indicator of reserve applying to stop instead of resetting.
[*] Player Statistics: fixed a bug that prevented another player’s statistics tab from closing during the Picks and Bans stage and on the Battle Statistics screen.
[*] Weapons screen: fixed a bug that caused a weapon to appear with an incorrect color after leaving the Practice mode.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Collector of Legend Emblem to be found only by searching Rookie.
[/list]

[h1]OPERATORS[/h1]

[b]General changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Suppressed effect: fixed a bug that caused an increased spread to remain after the effect had ended.
[*] AK-74M and AKS-74N: fixed a bug that prevented a sight from being attached to the weapon model.
[/list]


[b]Voron, SSO[/b]

Chernobog Mythic Outfit:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the first-person view that prevented the primary weapon’s barrel heating visual effects from showing.
[/list]


[b]Komar, SSO[/b]

[list]
[*] Piercing Shot ability: fixed a bug that prevented damage from reducing by 30% while shooting through covers with procured weapons.
[/list]


[b]Yàowáng, Jiaolong[/b]

[list]
[*] Upgrade #9: fixed a bug that caused internal strings to be displayed.
[/list]


[b]Saif, PÖH[/b]

[list]
[*] Operator tab: fixed a bug that made the primary weapon characteristics tab to always show 12 cartridges.
[/list]


[b]Sungur, PÖH[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that disabled upgrade #13-2.
[/list]

[h1]SOUND[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused all operators' voice lines to sound with a radio effect. Also fixed a bug with the voice chat being too loud.
[*] Battle Statistics: fixed a bug that caused sounds to disappear when receiving Battle Rewards.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1: Patch Note
notes.content:
Update 1.0.1 Is Available Now!

We celebrate Defender of the Fatherland Day with the Back into the Fray, Double Credits, and Double XP events!

What’s new: Showdown: First-Person View mode was added permanently, new Clan Season began, procured weapon and operator rebalance was performed, procured weapon customization was upgraded, new Emblems for collecting Legendary Outfits were added, and much more!

But that’s not all that we’ve got for you! A surprise is coming, so stay tuned!


[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[h2]CONTENT AND EVENTS:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Defender of the Fatherland Day event began: Back into the Fray, Double Credits, and Double XP.
[*] Clan Season 3 started.
[*] PvP game modes: removed Hacking mode, added Showdown: First-Person View mode.
[*] Showdown: First-Person View mode also added to User Battles.
[*] Weapon Customization: Epic and Legendary Weapon Outfits can be applied.
[*] User Battles: Interception mode added.
[/list]

---

Added a new progressing Emblem which will be given for collecting Legendary Outfits. As you reach new stages, the Emblem will be updated automatically. There are five levels:

[list]
[*] Rookie — 5 Legendary Outfits.
[*] Seeker — 10 Legendary Outfits.
[*] Collector — 20 Legendary Outfits.
[*] Connoisseur — 40 Legendary Outfits.
[*] Collector of Legend: Master — 80 Legendary Outfits.
[/list]

Collect Outfits and show everyone what a true collector you are!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/0406f1973c27937d4936631ee49051a500442fd8.jpg[/img]


[h2]FIXES:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Professional Emote: fixed a bug that prevented the Emote from being given to the PÖH collection.
[*] Ability visual effects: fixed incorrect display on low graphics settings.
[*] Fixed procured weapons’ significant crosshairs sway for Yíngzhōu, Odin, Svarog, and Busel.
[*] Fixed UI issues that appeared after entering Practice from the Reprisal tab.
[*] Fixed a typo on the “Create clan” screen.
[*] Veshtitsa Emblem: fixed a bug that increased SRAM.
[*] Weapon Customization tab: fixed a bug that prevented filters from being applied.
[*] Operators: fixed a bug that prevented special gear sounds from being played and made an incorrect icon to appear.
[*] Hunting Grounds HQ Background: fixed the water light shimmer.
[*] Operator Customization screen: fixed a bug that made operators pose incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug that made Sprint possible with special gear.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented bots (chemists, marksmen, and rocketeers) from switching to secondary weapon when fighting at close range.
[*] Fixed a bug that made duplicates to appear in Weapon Containers.
[*] Containers screen: fixed incorrect UI display on 2560х1600 screen resolution.
[*] Internal Reserve skill: fixed a spelling error in the description.
[*] “Use ability” setting: fixed a bug that prevented key bindings from changing and saving.
[*] First Blood skill: changed the description to make it more understandable.
[*] Threshold: fixed a bug that caused the game to crash during the second AA explosion with Sungur in battle.
[/list]


[h1]SKILLS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Self-Treatment: fixed a bug that made the skill to restore an incorrect number of HP.
[*] To the Max: fixed a bug that prevented the skill from increasing ability duration for a number of operators.
[*] Stimulant Medications: fixed a typo in the description.
[/list]


[h1]OPERATORS[/h1]

Check out a detailed description of all operator changes in a separate article: [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/1074/re-balance-update-1-0-1/]RE: Balance. [/url]

[/list]

[list]

[/list]

Chernobog Mythic Outfit:

[list]

[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the Purchase button on the Outfit’s tab from redirecting to the website.
[*] Primary weapon: fixed incorrect suppressor coloring when the barrel was heating.
[/list]

[/list]

[list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.0 is Available Now!

The first Outfit with Mythic rarity has appeared in Caliber: the Chernobog Outfit for Voron. The bundle with this outfit and a number of other unique items can be found on the website.

We have lifted the purchase limit on Weapon Containers that can be bought with Coins in the game client and decreased the number of openings needed for receiving a guaranteed weapon. Moreover, a new bundle with Elite Weapon Containers has been added to the website: it can be purchased five times a month.

In this hotfix, we have also fixed many issues.



[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[h2]CHERNOBOG MYTHIC OUTFIT[/h2]

[previewyoutube=uHwU_4sIcBo;full][/previewyoutube]

The first Outfit with Mythic rarity has appeared in Caliber: the Chernobog Outfit for Voron.

This outfit changes not only Voron’s appearance and weapon, but also his reloading animations, tracer color (for AK-12 without suppressor), case color, and ability and heated barrel visual effects.

The Outfit is included in the new bundle, which is already available on the website. As well as the Outfit, the bundle includes an HQ Background, animated Emblem, Camo, and exclusive Execution, Reprisal, and Emote animations for Voron.

[url=https://playcaliber.com/en/store/skins/chernobog/]CHERNOBOG[/url]


[h1]OTHER CHANGES[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/e937ce53025435590114bd28805f38236cf9bead.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Weapon Containers can be purchased with coins unlimited times.
[*] Weapon Containers can now be purchased with Coins in the in-game Showcase.
[*] Weapon Container: the number of openings for a guaranteed primary and secondary weapon drop is reduced. Before: 10 openings for a guaranteed primary and 20 for a guaranteed secondary weapon drop. Now: 5 and 10 openings respectively.
[*] A New Bundle with Elite Weapon Containers, Coins, and Army Surplus Containers was added to the website store. Up to five Bundles can be purchased per month. Each Elite Weapon Container has five equipment slots which guarantee at least one primary weapon, one secondary weapon, and one sight for an existing operator.
[*] Gift Hunt Container: adjusted description. Clarified that all clan members will receive container after purchasing. 
[*] Special gear: fixed incorrect mouse wheel toggle. 
[*] Special gear: fixed a bug that allowed leaving the game area.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused avatars of those eliminated with Reprisals to not display their status.
[*] Statistics: fixed a bug that caused incorrect data to display in player profile.
[*] Live the Old Tales Weekly Objective has ended.
[*] Gift Hunt mode: fixed a bug that caused Mad Ded to stop playing accordion during one of the mode stages.
[*] Gift Hunt, mode selection screen: fixed an incorrect event date.
[*] HQ: fixed incorrect marking of launching fireworks text.
[*] Ranked Battles: fixed incorrect avatar and nickname positions.
[*] Post-battle Statistics: fixed overlapping UI elements of Battle Pass name.
[*] Battle preparation screen: fixed incorrect weapon icons while choosing Camos.
[*] Weapon customization: fixed technical text in sight descriptions.
[/list]


[h1]OPERATORS[/h1]

[b]Saif, PÖH[/b]

[list]
[*] Tungsten special gear: fixed a bug that caused ammo to disappear when changing ammo type. The error occurred if the operator only had one magazine.
[*] Canik TP9 Golden pistol: fixed weapon model visual bugs.
[*] F1 tip window: fixed a bug that caused technical text to be displayed on the screen.
[/list]

[b]Primary weapon:[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased body and headshot damage from 14/16 to 15/18.
[*] Recoil decreased.
[*] Skills that affect primary weapon now work correctly when ammo type is changed to bullets.
[/list]


[b]Aslan, PÖH[/b]

[list]
[*] Milkor MGL special gear: armor penetration increased from 45% to 50%.
[*] Weapon customization: fixed a bug that caused the Canik TP9 settings window to disappear and a duplicate weapon icon to appear in menu.
[*] Canik TP9 Golden pistol: fixed weapon model visual bugs.
[/list]

[b]Primary weapon:[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased body and headshot damage from 20/27 to 22/30.
[*] Increased rate of fire from 8 to 9.
[/list]


[b]Sungur, PÖH[/b]

[list]
[*] Canik TP9 Golden pistol: fixed weapon model visual bugs.
[/list]

[b]Kirpi medical drone ability: [/b]

[list]
[*] Visual aura effect added.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused drone to explode immediately near wounded ally.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused drone to destroy objects (mines, PRD, etc.) when exploding.
[/list]


[b]Tirkesh, PÖH[/b]

notes.title: Caliber Turns Five!
notes.content:
It has been 5 years since our game was released in OBT. During this time, millions of battles have been played, a lot of work has been done, and a lot of lessons have been learned. 
This year, we have tried to pay more attention to your feedback and wishes.

Long-awaited clans have come to Caliber, and we already have ideas on their development. Also, statistics and the first-person view have appeared in the game as well as new operators and improvements to the old ones. We have been working on the game modes and various events.

Together we’ve experienced the excitement of tournament livestreams, where we could see hot battles and unique game situations.

Thank you for playing, sharing comments, and being active in other ways on our social networks. Thank you for being with us all this time and believing in us. Without you there would be no Caliber.

In the current update, we tried to delight you with new content: we have prepared the long-awaited Arystan Legendary Outfits with an unexpected trailer as well as the themed Halloween: Shadows of Fear mode and an event with various rewards. Thank you for lots of kind words and feedback: they motivate us to move forward.

There is something more: we have left one of the gifts for today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/85f7b98fb49d873724a1688fe1e9ca7406928814.jpg[/img]

On behalf of our entire team, we congratulate all of us on this holiday. There are more interesting things to come!

notes.title: Update 0.25.0: patch note
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=1Mlx_TKjk20;full][/previewyoutube]

Update 0.25.0 is Available Now!

The holiday has come: a new Technological Superiority Battle Pass with Arystan Legendary Outfits added together with the unit’s rebalance, Caliber’s Birthday and Halloween 2024 events started, a new Shadows of Fear event mode added, Frontline and Onslaught: Legend modes returned to the PvE category. Also, there was a number of tweaks and fixes.

The full list of changes is already in the patch note.

Happy holiday, fighters!

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added Technological Superiority Battle Pass.
[*] Now, after acquiring a Battle Pass episode, you receive +10% Battle Pass XP when completing said episode. Bonus XP is calculated off base XP received at the end of a battle.
[*] Added [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/1026/arystan-legendary-outfits-karakurt-trailer/]Karakurt Legendary Outfits[/url] for the operators of the Arystan collection.
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/1028/calibers-birthday-objectives-and-containers/]Caliber's Birthday 2024 even[/url] has begun.
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/1022/halloween-shadows-of-fear/]Halloween 2024[/url] event has begun.
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/1024/a-holiday-for-everyone/]Frontline and Onslaught: Legend modes have been made always available again.[/url] Frontline is available from Account Level 20, and Onslaught: Legend from Account Level 30.
[*] Removed bonus XP for selecting all modes in the PvE category.
[*] Second Clan Season has begun.
[*] Objective window updated.
[*] Removed Elite Objectives.
[*] Clan Emblems for the previous season have been awarded. Clan Emblems are awarded and updated after a Clan Season has been completed.
[*] Added Clan Badges for taking the 4th and 5th places in the previous season. 
[*] Referral Program: Added 10% Coin cashback for the inviting player. If the invited player acquires Coins or Bundles containing Coins through the game’s website, Steam page, or VK Play, you will receive 10% of the total amount of Coins in the Bundle. Cashback from an invited player will be awarded when that player reaches level 25.
[*] Referral Program: Added visual display for received rewards in the Referral Program window.
[*] Added mouse sensitivity settings for every operator.
[*] Added an ability to block notifications from other players.
[*] "Alternative use of an ability" option removed.
[*] Onslaught: Legend mode: fixed the description.
[*] Added the Superiority Camo for the 1st Prestige level.
[*] Added a new emblem for Polygon participants.
[*] Added new items for the new Pumpkin Feast Twitch Drops season.
[*] Extra XP has been removed from the game. All unused Extra XP has been converted into credits.
[*] Fixed an error that made it impossible to start the battle if a Fireteam member was in the Container rewards selection screen.
[*] Replays, Ranked Battles: fixed an error that caused zeroes to be displayed instead of the ranked league.
[*] Threshold mode, all maps: fixed an error that caused the Heavy Fighter elimination bonus to persist after its duration had run out.
[*] Fixed an error that made it impossible to create a User Battle.
[*] Threshold mode: fixed an error that prevented the number of players who started a match search from being displayed.
[*] Skills: fixed descriptions for certain skills.
[/list]

[/list]

[*] Increased the contrast of the reticle when using the base Outfit.

notes.title: Update 0.24.1: patch note
notes.content:
Update 0.24.1 is installed.

What’s new: the Long Run Marathon, a new Commander clan role, the Oil Platform map added to the Onslaught mode, operator rebalance, and a number of bug fixes.

A complete list of changes can be found in a patch note.


[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Increased prices of Coins, Caliber+, and Epic and Legendary Outfits.
[*] Bundles with Legendary and Epic Outfits will be available for purchase at a 20% discount on the website until September 18. 
[*] The [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/1007/long-run-marathon-september-11-october-23/]Long Run Marathon[/url] has started.
[*] Clans: added the new Commander role. Officer permissions have been changed.
[*] Onslaught mode: Oil Platform map added.
[*] Settings: added the ability to disable health bars above allied operators.
[*] Clans: fixed a bug that allowed sending a clan invitation to a player who was already in it.
[*] Special Operation mode: fixed a bug whereby a revived operator could receive two health penalties at once. The bug occurred if two allies performed a revival at the same time.
[*] Threshold mode: fixed a bug whereby documents could fall inside a cover.
[*] Replays: fixed incorrect designation of one of the teams.
[*] Clans: fixed incorrect function of the "Back" button and sorting on the Objectives screen.
[*] Clans: fixed a bug whereby a kicked player's clan level was displayed incorrectly.
[*] Tutorial: fixed a bug that made it impossible to collect rewards for completing the tutorial.
[*] Kill log: fixed a bug that caused an incorrect weapon icon to be displayed.
[*] Lost connection window: fixed window freezing.
[/list]

[h1]OPERATORS[/h1]

[h3][url=https://playcaliber.com/en/patch-notes/0-24-1-rebalance/]Check out a detailed description of all operator changes in a separate article: RE: Balance.[/url][/h3]


[b]Almaz, Vympel[/b]

[list]
[*] Aegis Ability: fixed a bug that caused operator stamina to regenerate while the ability was active.
[/list]

[b]Sputnik, SSO[/b]

[list]
[*] Recon Drone Special gear: fixed a bug whereby the EMP effect did not stun bots.
[/list]

[b]Prorok, GROM[/b]

[list]
[*] Smokescreen Ability: fixed a bug that caused field bonuses to disappear within the ability radius.
[/list]

[b]Corsair, SEAL[/b]

[list]
[*] C-4 Special gear: fixed incorrect display of the explosion radius when attaching C-4 to an enemy/ally.
[/list]

[b]Bones, CST[/b]

[list]
[*] Melee: fixed a bug that caused the gunshot sound to play when using a knife.
[/list]

[b]Bastion, RAID[/b]

[list]
[*] Reflect Ability: fixed a bug that prevented the activation sound effect from playing.
[*] Reflect Ability: fixed incorrect display of melee damage during the ability's duration.
[/list]

[b]Velour, RAID[/b]

[list]
[*] Upgrade #6-3: fixed a bug whereby the upgrade continued to work after exiting smoke.
[*] Upgrade #13-3: fixed a bug that caused reserve recovery time to decrease more than it should.
[/list]

[b]Starkaðr, AMF[/b]

[list]
[*] Onslaught mode, Incendiary Ammo field bonus: fixed a bug whereby activating the bonus made an operator with an active ability switch to their primary weapon.
[/list]

[h3]SAS[/h3]

[list]
[*] SAS collection: fixed a bug whereby ignited incapacitated operators continued to burn until respawn/revival.
[/list]

[b]Spark, SAS[/b]

[list]
[*] Defibrillator Special gear: fixed a bug whereby the charged special gear did not deal full damage.
[*] Chain Healing Ability: fixed a bug whereby the ability charge could bounce onto an eliminated enemy.
[/list]

[h1]MAPS, MODES AND BOTS[/h1]

[h3]GENERAL CHANGES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Showdown mode: fixed a bug whereby the round would not end after using a Reprisal on an operator affected by the Invulnerability effect.
[*] Forest and Amal Harbor maps: fixed a bug whereby operators were not slowed down in the gas area.
[*] Onslaught mode, Incendiary Ammo field bonus: fixed a bug that granted endless incendiary ammo.
[*] Onslaught mode, “Players: Increased defense and speed while sprinting” modifier: fixed a bug that provided movement speed increase for any movement.
[*] Onslaught mode, "Bots: Always visible" modifier: fixed a bug that caused bot marking to work incorrectly.
[*] Annihilation mode, Hold the Line field bonus: fixed a bug whereby a revive statistic was awarded to the player being revived.
[*] Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that prevented the Everybody Comes Home Ribbon from being awarded.
[*] Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that awarded a win with one incapacitated player in the evacuation area.
[/list]

[h3]SHOPPING MALL[/h3]

[b]PvE Version [/b]

[list]
[*] Point Sweep and Special Operation modes: removed unnecessary collision near one of the shelves on the map.
[/list]

[h3]PALM ROAD[/h3]

[b]PvE Version [/b]

[list]
[*] Point Sweep and Special Operation modes: fixed a bug that allowed leaving the play area.
[/list]

[h3]FOREST[/h3]

[b]PvE Version [/b]

[list]
[*] Point Sweep and Special Operation modes, Support Tower: fixed a bug that allowed Tower's special gear to deal damage to Delgado despite him being invincible.
[*] Point Sweep and Special Operation modes, Medic Mikołaj: fixed a bug whereby the Field Hospital could fall through a grate in the floor.
[/list]

[h3]RADAR[/h3]

[b]PvE Version [/b]

[list]
[*] Point Sweep and Special Operation modes: fixed a bug whereby the stun icon would not disappear.
[/list]

[h3]OIL PLATFORM[/h3]

[b]PvE Version [/b]

[list]
[*] Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that caused a client freeze when a demolition drone was attacked with melee.
[/list]

[h3]SOUND[/h3]

[list]
[*] Threshold mode: fixed incorrect notification about capturing allied Intel.
[*] Practice mode: fixed a bug whereby the voice line did not play after marking an allied dummy with (C).
[*] Fixed a bug whereby the radio noise would continue until the end of the battle.
[*] User Battles: fixed a bug whereby the shooting sound would not stop during a pause.
[/list]

notes.title: RE: Balance: Update 0.24.1
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
 
In the new RE: Balance, we've buffed some of the not-so-popular operators to bring them back into the action. We've added the auto-fire upgrade for Bard, completely reworked Sztylet's firing, and made Corsair, Starkaðr, and Martelo's firing more comfortable.
 
You can find the complete list of changes in this article.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/b27844e8e82652044ff8c3de28984dfd8dd793bd.jpg[/img]
 

[h1]OPERATOR BALANCE CHANGES[/h1]
 
[h2]VYMPEL[/h2]
 
[b]Medic Ded[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Vega Legendary Outfit, primary weapon: fixed reticle movement.
[/list]
 
[h2]ALPHA[/h2]
 
[b]Medic Travnik[/b]

[list]
[*] Primary weapon: increased reticle contrast.
[/list]
 
[h2]SSO[/h2]
 
[b]Support Sputnik[/b]

[list]
[*] Primary weapon: Horizontal recoil decreased by 15%.
[/list]
 
[b]Medic Bard[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Added a new linear upgrade #13: full auto mode (primary weapon), damage decrease (-2), headshot damage decrease (-5), rate of fire decrease (-7), horizontal recoil (+5%), recoil decrease after first shot (-20%).
[*] Primary weapon: 1 magazine added.
[*] (new) Enthusiastic ability: activation time decreased from 1 second to 0,5 when pressing and holding the key.
[*] (new) Enthusiastic ability: area of effect increased from 4 meters to 5.
[*] (new) Enthusiastic ability: duration increased from 7 seconds to 8.
[/list]
 
[h2]22 SPN[/h2]

[b]Support Kit[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Primary weapon: 1 magazine added.
[*] Linear upgrade #10: "75-round magazine": now additionally decreases the magazines' amount by 1.
[/list]
 
[b]Medic Karavai[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Increased movement speed by +0.2.
[/list]
 
[h2]GROM[/h2]
 
[b]Assault Koszmar[/b] 

[list]
[*] Increased movement speed by 0.1.
[*] Upgrade #15-2: “Increased damage radius of the special gear”: radius bonus increased from +1 m to +2 m.
[/list]
 
[b]Support Prorok[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #14-2: “Special gear damage increase”: damage increase reduced from +2 to +4.
[*] New upgrade #12-3 added: "Primary and secondary weapon damage increases when in smoke and while the ability is active. Damage: +10%".
[/list]
 
Medic Mikołaj

[list]
[*] Linear upgrade #9: "Ammo replacement: Tac-8 buckshot": armor penetration bonus increased by +5%. It is now 40% instead of 35%.
[*] Linear upgrade #9: "Ammo replacement: Tac-8 buckshot": now additionally increases the effective range by +3 m.
[*] Secondary weapon: decreased damage fall-off at a distance of 30 m, from 9.5 to 12.
[*] Emergency Care ability: activation cost decreased from 70 SP to 55 SP.
[/list]
 
[b]Marksman Sztylet[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #8-2: Bolt carrier group modification": Rate of fire increased by +0.2, from +0.5 to +0.7.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.24.0
notes.content:
A hotfix has just been applied to the game.

We have fixed a number of bugs that had appeared in the 0.24.0 update: issues with clans and chat, Velour's #13-3 upgrade, and infinite Crossing in Onslaught mode.

Also, the New Status Battle Pass became available today.


[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] The period for completing The Rough 90s Battle Pass has ended.
[*] Added the New Status Battle Pass.
[*] The Double Credits event has ended.
[*] User Battles: fixed a bug that allowed opening chat during cutscenes.
[*] Battle chat: fixed large gaps between messages.
[*] Battle Statistics: fixed a bug where number of revivals wouldn’t display.
[*] Contacts: fixed a bug whereby the “In a fireteam” status was displayed for all friends at once.
[*] Settings: added the option to assign melee to a separate key.
[/list]

[b]Clans:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would prevent creating a clan if the minimum account level was set to 100.
[*] Search: added sorting by language.
[*] Joining request: fixed a bug whereby the Cancel button was inactive if there were no free spots in the clan.
[*] Search: fixed a bug whereby your clan would not be highlighted in the list.
[/list]

[b]Clan chat:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the location of the menu that opens when you right-click on a player's nickname.
[*] Fixed incorrect layout of chat tabs.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused chat history to disappear after a battle.
[/list]


[h1]OPERATORS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Clinging to Life Skill: fixed a bug where the incapacitated state lasted much longer than intended.
[*] SAS Collection: fixed a bug that prevented purchasing operators from this collection.
[*] Medic Velour: fixed incorrect value of the effective shooting distance reduction in the description of linear upgrade #9.
[*] Medic Velour: fixed incorrect value of the effective shooting distance reduction in the description of linear upgrade #9.
[*] Medic Velour, #13-3 upgrade: fixed a bug that allowed operators with the Heavy ammo pack Skill to immediately restore Ammo Reserves by using two Velour bags.
[/list]


[h1]MAPS, MODELS AND BOTS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Onslaught mode, Crossing: reduced drop frequency. Fixed evacuation area size.
[*] Point Sweep and Special Operation modes, Al-Malik Hotel: fixed a bug that caused a zone from another mode to appear.
[*] Ranked Battle: Threshold mode, Depot: fixed a bug whereby the grenadier bot got stuck in the spawn room. Also fixed a bug where the bot’s cover was not displayed.
[/list]

notes.title: Competitions for Clans
notes.content:
Clans are already available! To honor this occasion, we are announcing TWO competitions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/10f99f1b7d2a2dcd9e204fbb31ca10b8a556d955.jpg[/img]

[h3]1. The most active clan.[/h3]

The point of this competition is to earn Season Points. Your objective is to take the highest place on the Top Players leaderboard and hold it until August 7, 11 AM UTC. At this time, we will record the results.

The Top Players leaderboard was chosen for a reason. It counts the results of the top 10 players of each clan, which means that you don’t have to be in a large clan to participate.

Rewards will be sent to all members of the winning clans within five business days after announcing the results:

• First place: 10 Army Surplus Containers + 400,000 Credits.
• Second place: 5 Army Surplus Containers + 200,000 Credits.
• Third place: 3 Army Surplus Containers + 200,000 Credits.
 
[h3] 2. The first large clan.[/h3]

The second activity will require you to demonstrate recruitment and socialization skills.

Your objective is to be the first who gathers the maximum number of participants in one clan (200 people) and earns 100,000 Season Points on the All Players leaderboard. As soon as you fulfill these conditions, please contact our community manager BadBishop on Discord and send him a screenshot that depicts your result.

When we have our winner, this competition will end. If you succeed, you and all your clan members will receive a unique "Strength in unity!” Emblem, which cannot be obtained in any other way. It has an indefinite period of exclusivity.

Important! If your clan contains an abnormal number of players with new accounts that have been created to complete the objective, or if we notice any other suspicious activity, we may disqualify you without explanation.

Play fair. Let the competitions begin!
