notes.title: RE: Balance: Update 0.24.0
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
 
This new rebalance brings major changes to the Stamina system, adjustments to skills, operator bonuses against bots, upgrade updates for RAID operators, melee, and much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/6f3ac7801c23fc4eb00a3ac0d19c588fb44eb9c6.jpg[/img]



[h1]STAMINA: WHAT'S NEW?[/h1]
 
We continue to enhance the Stamina system to make gameplay more comfortable. At the same time, we’re working to keep Stamina management as a tactical component.
 
Starting from the next update, operators will have their Stamina fully recovered at the beginning of each round and after respawning. Also, Stamina will now replenish while abilities are active.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/d87a8ecaa34a7daf6cb8f8d30f2d6294f2dcfab2.gif[/img]
 
Affected modes:
 
[list]
[*] Showdown
[*] Hacking
[*] Onslaught
[*] Annihilation
[*] Threshold
[*] Skirmish (available in User Battles)
[/list]
 
We realize that this change will affect the established metagame, but it's time to stir it up! This mostly affects skills, so we're gonna update them, too.



[h1]SKILL REBALANCE[/h1] 

Over 30 skills have been rebalanced. Below are their current versions, along with the updated ones.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/36541bc73fc94a5273123dbbeb41eb052b56e33a.jpg[/img]

[h2]SLEIGHT OF HAND[/h2]
 
Medic Ded's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Speeds up application of Reserve effects and decreases cooldown time. Cooldown: -15/20/25%. Application speed: +15/20/25%.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Speeds up application of Reserve effects and decreases cooldown time. Cooldown: [b]-20/25/30%[/b] Application speed: [b]+20/25/30%.[/b]

[h2]RESPIRATORY TRAINING[/h2]
 
Assault Volk's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Special breathing practice increases Stamina Recovery Speed. Recovery speed: 1/1.5/2 SP/sec.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Special breathing practice increases Stamina Recovery Speed. Recovery speed: [b]+2/3/4 SP/sec.[/b]
 
[h2]ADVANCED TRAINING[/h2]
 
Assault Mustang's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Thanks to advanced physical fitness, the operator returns to battle with more Stamina. Minimum Stamina: +125/200/275 SP.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
The operator's maximum HP is increased by 1 for every 150/125/100 of maximum SP. Increases the operator's maximum SP: +100 SP.

[h2]DUCK AND WEAVE[/h2]
 
Assault Plut's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Advanced movement training increases the operator's resistance to bullet and explosion damage while sprinting. Incoming damage: -9/12/15%.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Advanced movement practice under fire increases the operator's resistance to bullet and explosion damage while sprinting. Incoming damage: [b]-10/15/17%.[/b]

[h2]HEMOSTATIC SERUM[/h2]
 
Support Bourbon's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Experimental serum. Increases the operator's maximum HP, but decreases their Stamina. Max HP: +5/10/15 HP Stamina: -100 SP
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Experimental serum. Increases the operator's maximum HP, [b]but decreases incoming healing from all sources by 15%. Max HP: +5/10/15.[/b]

[h2]SELF-TREATMENT[/h2]
 
Assault Perun's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
If the operator's HP drops below 20/30/40% HP, they start regenerating it up to that value. The operator must not take damage for 5 seconds. Regeneration rate: 2% HP/sec.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
If the operator's HP drops below [b]25/35/45%[/b] HP, they start regenerating it up to that value. The operator must not take damage for [b]7 seconds.[/b] Regeneration rate: [b]2%[/b] HP/sec.

[h2]CLINGING TO LIFE[/h2]
 
Assault Sterling's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
The operator can crawl faster when critically wounded. Movement Speed increase: +50/75/100%
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Increases Movement Speed while incapacitated, as well as [b]incapacitation time.[/b] Movement Speed increase: +50/75/100%.[b] Incapacitated duration: +20%.[/b]

[h2]SIXTH SENSE[/h2]
 
Marksman Víðarr's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
The operator's Movement Speed increases while affected by the Marked effect. Movement Speed: +8/12/15%
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
The operator's Movement Speed increases while affected by the Marked effect. Movement Speed: [b]+10/15/20% Also receives immunity to the Slowed effect.[/b]

[h2]HIDDEN MOVEMENT[/h2]
 
Marksman Busel's personal skill. Moved to Combat tactics slot.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
The operator moves faster while crouched. All sounds made by them, except for shooting, are muffled. Movement Speed increase: +10/15/20% Sound volume reduction: -75%.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
The operator moves faster while crouched. All sounds they make, except for shooting, are muffled. [b]If the operator does not move for 3/2.5/2 sec. while crouched, they receive the Invisible effect.[/b] Movement Speed increase: +10/15/20%.

[h2]GUNPOINT[/h2] 

Marksman Avalanche's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Movement speed while in primary weapon aiming mode is increased by 10/15/20%.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Increases Movement Speed and [b]decreases spread[/b] while aiming with primary weapon by [b]5/10/15%.[/b]
 
[h2]FRESH FORCES[/h2]
 
Assault Martelo's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
    	
The prep time for the operator's primary ability is decreased, but their maximum health is decreased. Ability prep time: -33% HP decrease: -30/25/20%
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
The cooldown of the operator's primary ability is reduced, but their maximum health is decreased and the [b]ability activation cost is increased.[/b] Cooldown: [b]-15/25/33%.[/b] [b]Ability activation cost: +40/35/30% HP: -10%.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/9caf1fa3f0137355cf9b0d724b4611e64b45ded5.jpg[/img]

[h2]SNUG FIT[/h2]
 
Medic Velour's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Properly selected uniform and equipment significantly increase the operator's comfort. While the operator has full AP, they recover Stamina faster. Bonus Stamina recovery: 4/6/8 SP/sec.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
While the operator has full AP, or if they had 0 AP at the start of the battle, they recover Stamina faster, [b]but lose 20 AP.[/b] Bonus Stamina recovery: 4/6/8 SP/sec.
 
[h2]LIGHTWEIGHT PROTECTION[/h2]
 
Support Svarog's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
The operator loses 20 AP but gains additional Stamina. Stamina increase: +100/150/200 SP
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
The operator loses 20 AP but gains additional Stamina. Stamina increase: +100/150/200 SP [b]If their maximum AP is 40 or less, primary weapon recoil is decreased by 8%.[/b]

[h2]READINESS[/h2]
 
Medic Yàowáng's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
When an enemy is within 4/5/6 meters of the operator, the operator deals more damage to them with their primary and secondary weapons. Damage increase: +10/12/15%
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
When an enemy is within 4/5/6 meters of the operator, the operator deals more damage to them with their primary and secondary weapons. Damage increase: [b]+9/11/13%[/b]
 
[h2]STIMULANT MEDICATIONS[/h2]
 
Medic Shersheret's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Using the First Aid Kit reserve restores Stamina as well as HP. Stamina recovery: 70/105/140 SP over 3 sec. Cooldown between uses: 40 sec. The duration of activation increases to 4 sec.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Using the First Aid Kit reserve restores Stamina as well as HP. Stamina recovery: 70/105/140 SP over 3 sec. Cooldown between uses: [b]35 sec. Can be used while HP is full.[/b]

[h2]ENHANCED PROTECTION[/h2]
 
Support Barreira's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
The operator's armor is enhanced, but their Movement Speed is decreased by 30/25/20% in all conditions except heavily wounded. Armor enhancement: +20 AP
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
The operator's armor is enhanced, but their Movement Speed is decreased by [b]17/15/13% [/b]in all conditions except heavily wounded. Armor: +20 AP

[h2]EXTRA LAYER[/h2]
 
Support Tower's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
If the operator uses an Armor Plate while their armor is full, it grants an additional 20 AP. Activation time is increased by 1 sec. reserve recovery — by 20/15/10 sec.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Using an Armor Plate [b]applies the Shielded effect for 15 seconds.[/b] Reserve cooldown: +20/15/10 sec. Shield durability, HP: 15/20/25.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/6d7cffe9318ba083dac2ef7f382c7c44c9b239db.jpg[/img]

[h2]ARMOR PIERCING ROUNDS[/h2]
 
Marksman Archer's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Standard ammo for primary weapon replaced with an armor-piercing variant. Armor Penetration: +5/10/15%
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Standard ammo for primary weapon is replaced with an armor-piercing variant. Armor Penetration: +5/10/15%. [b]Primary weapon spread: +20/15/10%.[/b]

[h2]HEAVY AMMO PACK[/h2]
 
Support Kit's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
The Ammo Pack Reserve replenishes special gear instead of primary and secondary weapon ammo. Cooldown before repeated application: 720/480/360 sec. Application time increased to 5 sec.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Using the Ammo Pack Reserve replenishes special gear. Cooldown before next application: 720/480/360 sec. Application time increased to 5 sec.
 
[b]Game designer's comment: [/b]The skill no longer has its negative characteristic. Ammo Pack now replenishes both special gear and ammo.

[h2]THERMOGRAPHIC SIGHT[/h2]
 
Marksman Diablo's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
The operator activates a thermal imagery sight. Targets in smoke are highlighted when you're in aiming mode. Activation time: 1/0.5/0.25 sec.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
The operator activates a thermal imaging sight. Targets in smoke are highlighted while in aiming mode using the [b]primary weapon,[/b] and [b]operators with the Invisible effect are inflicted with a personal Marked effect.[/b] Activation time: 1/0.5/0.25 sec.

[h2]ADDITIONAL POUCHES[/h2]
 
Support Sputnik's personal skill. Moved to Combat tactics slot.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Additional set of pouches allowing the operator to carry more Reserves. Reserve stock in battle: +1/2/3 of each type.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
An additional set of pouches allows the operator to carry more Reserves. Reserve stock in battle: [b]+3/4/5[/b] of each type. [b]Revival kits: +1 pc.[/b]

[h2]FRUGALITY[/h2]
 
Marksman Scout's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
At the end of each round, unexploded mines are returned to the operator. Maximum returned mines: 1/2/3 pcs.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
[b]The operator installs mines faster.[/b] At the end of each round, unexploded mines are returned to the operator. Mine installation speed: +25/35/45%.

[h2]ENHANCED STIMULANTS[/h2]
 
Medic Freyr's personal skill. Moved to Physical fitness slot.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Applying Stimulant Reserve restores more Stamina. While the Reserve is active, the operator takes less damage. Stamina regeneration: +60/80/120 SP Damage resistance: +6/8/10% Cooldown between uses: 40 sec. The duration of activation increases to 4 sec.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Applying the Stimulant Reserve restores more Stamina. While the Reserve is active, the operator takes less damage and [b]becomes immune to fire and smoke.[/b] Stamina recovery: +60/80/120 SP Duration: 10 sec.

[h2]LIGHTWEIGHT CHEST RIG[/h2]
 
Support Hagana's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Reduces primary and secondary weapon ammo by 1 magazine, but increases the operator's Stamina and Movement Speed in all conditions. Stamina increase: +100/125/150 SP Movement Speed increase: +5% Ammo cannot be lower than 1 magazine.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Reduces primary and secondary weapon ammo by 1 magazine, but increases the operator's Stamina and Movement Speed in all conditions. [b]Increases primary and secondary weapon reload speed. Reload speed: +10/15/20%.[/b] Stamina increase: +100/125/150 SP Movement Speed increase: 5% Ammo cannot be less than 1 magazine.

[h2]ZEROING[/h2]
 
Marksman Bell's personal skill. Moved to Combat tactics slot.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Eliminating an enemy with a headshot applies the Focus and Haste effects to the operator. Primary weapon spread and recoil are reduced, and movement speed is increased by 10/15/20% for 5 sec. Focus: Weapon stats are temporarily increased. Haste: The operator's movement speed is temporarily increased. If the same weapon is equipped as primary and secondary, the skill applies to both.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Eliminating an enemy with a headshot applies the Focus and Haste effects to the operator. Primary weapon spread and recoil, as well as Movement Speed boost, are reduced by [b]8/12/15%[/b] for 5 sec. If the same weapon is used as both primary and secondary, the skill applies to both.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/9bd88bec275562d39177a3bf4c6a80f3a3c0dd01.jpg[/img]

[h2]SPARE SYRINGE[/h2]
 
Medic Mikołaj's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Revival Kit Stock increase. Revival Kits: +1/2/3 pcs.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Revival Kit Stock increase. Revival Kits: [b]+2/3/4 pcs.[/b]

[h2]REFINED FORMULA[/h2]
 
Medic Miguel's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Revived teammates receive a temporary Movement Speed boost, while you receive a Stamina boost. Duration: 5 sec. Stamina recovery: 100/125/150 SP Movement Speed: +10/15/20%
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Reviving a teammate provides a Stamina boost, as well as a temporary Movement Speed boost to the [b]operator[/b] and revived teammate. Duration: [b]8 sec.[/b] Stamina recovery: 100/125/150 SP Movement Speed: +10/15/20%.

[h2]SILENT WARRIOR[/h2]
 
Support Prorok's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
The operator's Movement Speed and primary and secondary weapon damage are increased while they are in smoke. Movement Speed in smoke: +9/12/15% Primary and secondary weapon damage in smoke: +6/8/10% .
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Operator's Movement Speed is increased and [b]they take less bullet and explosion damage[/b] while they are in smoke. Movement Speed in smoke: +9/12/15% Incoming bullet and explosion damage in smoke: -8/10/12%.

[h2]COUNTERATTACK[/h2]
 
Support Bastion's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
After taking a certain number of hits from firearms, damage dealt by the operator's weapons is increased for 8 seconds. Hits received: 5/4/3 Damage increase: +8/10/15%.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
After taking a certain number of hits from firearms, damage dealt by the operator's weapons is increased for 8 seconds. Hits received: 5/4/3 Damage: [b]+6/8/10%.[/b]

[h2]LONE WOLF[/h2]
 
Marksman Sokol's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
For each incapacitated teammate, the operator gains additional resistance to damage dealt by bullets and explosions. Resistance: +3/4/5%.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
For each incapacitated teammate, the operator gains additional resistance to bullet and explosion damage and [b]recovers their Stamina faster.[/b] Resistance: +3/4/5%. [b]Stamina recovery speed: +1/2/3 SP/sec.[/b]

[h2]MERCILESSNESS[/h2]
 
Support Bishop's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
The operator takes less damage from bullets and explosions during Executions. Damage: -50/60/70%.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
The operator takes less bullet and explosion damage when executing enemies. [b]The operator recovers 20 AP after a successful Execution.[/b] Damage: -50/60/70%.

[h2]PERSONAL PRIORITIES[/h2]
 
Assault Sly's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
Improved stats for your secondary weapon. Ammo: +3 magazines (up to 7). Armor penetration: +15%. Effective range: +10 m. Headshot damage: +5%. Reduced stats for your primary weapon. Reload time: +20/15/10%. Ammo: -1 magazine (down to 1). The skill does not affect operators that use the same primary and secondary weapon.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Improved stats for your secondary weapon. Ammo: +2 magazines (up to 7). Armor penetration: +15%. Effective range: +10 m. Headshot damage: +5%. The skill does not affect operators that use the same primary and secondary weapon.

[h2]PRIORITY TARGET[/h2]
 
Marksman Caçador's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
An enemy who incapacitates the operator receives the Marked effect and cannot be healed for 3/5/6 sec.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
[b]Damage dealt to enemies inflicted with the Marked effect is increased by 5/6/7%.[/b] An enemy who incapacitates the operator receives the Marked effect and cannot be healed for 3/5/6 sec.

[h2]SHARED FIRST-AID KIT[/h2]
 
Medic Açaí's personal skill.
 
[b]Before:[/b]
 
The self-healing effect of the First Aid Kit is decreased by 10 HP. Each teammate within a 3-meter radius of the player restores 12/16/20 HP over 4 sec.
 
[b]Now:[/b]
 
Using the First Aid Kit Reserve restores 12/16/20 HP to teammates within a [b]5-meter[/b] radius of the operator over 4 sec.


[h1]MELEE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/ffa7189eba8e6888f877d093a660ae49e45c4f42.jpg[/img]
 
Update 0.24.0 brings melee to Caliber. Press [V] to attack an enemy with a knife.
 
Stabbing an operator deals 50 damage.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/41f05668762685ef87260dfb1c43c3a39bb1d2f7.gif[/img]
 
If you were able to sneak up on an enemy from behind, you can eliminate them with a single hit. No reviving.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/44b39c4c2d87b5234f0c8b4e39ed294cd767fe8b.gif[/img]


[h1]RAID[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/dcd1986f8cb6ccfd07770f0f6d8a4cb42116207c.jpg[/img]
 
You may remember how we renewed the Vympel collection with our last update by changing operator upgrades. RAID is next on the list!
 
[b]Assault Avant-garde[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/44741a49d76da1102a031bb53792af582f60600b.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Base stats:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Increased sprint speed from 5.5 to 5.7.
[*] Increased Movement speed from 3.7 to 3.8.
[*] Increased Stamina cost of sprinting from 9 to 10.
[/list]

[b]Vengeance ability: [/b]
 
[list]
[*] The ability no longer checks for Shielded status. Previously, if the operator was Shielded, the effect would not refresh on using the ability.
[/list]

[b]Primary weapon:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Increased effective range by 10%.
[*] Reduced magazine ammo from 10 to 7.
[*] Increased the number of magazines from 3 to 4.
[*] Linear upgrade #6: "Vertical Tactical Foregrip": now additionally reduces Sprint speed by 0.1 and vertical recoil by 30% (instead of 20%).
[*] Linear upgrade #10: "Longer Barrel": now additionally reduces Sprint speed by 0.4 and increases stability by 12% (instead of 7%).
[*] Linear upgrade #14: "12-Round Magazine": now additionally reduces Sprint speed by 0.2 and increases magazine capacity by 5 rounds (instead of 2). Reduces the number of magazines by 1.
[/list]

[b]Game designer's comment: [/b]The main changes affect movement speed and provide level-up flexibility. You can make Avant-garde faster at the cost of his combat potential, or you can choose all linear upgrades, which will make him extremely effective at both medium and close range, but less mobile.

[h2]REVAMPED UPGRADES[/h2]
 
[b]New upgrades:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #6-3: The operator deals +10% additional limb damage with their primary weapon while the ability is active.
[/list]
 
[b]Game designer's comment: [/b]Since Avant-garde uses pellets, this new upgrade will be useful for players who prefer to fire at random. Pellets will very likely hit enemy limbs.
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #9-2: Using the ability no longer inflicts the Marked effect on the operator. Ability duration is reduced by 2 sec.
[/list]
 
[b]Game designer's comment: [/b]This upgrade works nicely for those who choose a speed build for Avant-garde. You will be undetectable, thus able to outflank enemies without drawing attention.
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #14-3: Special gear upgrade. Special gear explodes on surface contact. Stunned effect replaced with Slowed. Slowed duration: 3 sec. Gas cloud duration: -4 sec. Gas damage: +10/sec. Movement speed: -40%.
[/list]
 
[b]Changed upgrades:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #3-2: "Increased base Stamina by 25 SP" changed to "Increased damage reflected by the ability by 2%."
[*] Upgrade #7-1: Increased damage reflected by the ability by 5% (instead of 3%).
[*] Upgrade #9-1: Increased duration of the ability by 2 (instead of 1).
[*] Upgrade #12-2 now changes Shielded requirements. The effect is applied when the enemy is hit with the primary weapon while the ability is active. Hits to activate: 3 Shielded duration: -5 sec. Shield durability: -10 HP Previously, this upgrade increased base Stamina by 50 SP.
[/list]
 
[b]Game designer's comment:[/b] Upgrade #12-2 will make it easier to receive the Shielded effect, which makes the operator more effective at close range.
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #14-2: "Increased base Stamina": was +75 SP now +150 SP.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/c0c8b5c380b64d8dcdbe966b3da2583797a0e02d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/45f8c955c416097c7ad3562a7bce9bec9c114771.jpg[/img]

[b]Support Bastion[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/67c214c6bbfcc2b14858655b6350abdfb795cd59.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Primary weapon:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Increased the number of magazines from 4 to 5.
[*] Increased recoil and spread by ~25%.
[/list]
 
[b]Game designer's comment:[/b] Bastion's weapon is too precise, and its spread is narrow, which allows fighting at medium range. This is not how this operator was designed—he is supposed to be played with a team and fight at close range.
 
[h2]REVAMPED UPGRADES[/h2]
 
[b]New upgrades:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #4-3: Reduced ability cooldown by 2 sec.
[*] Upgrade #14-3: Increased Movement Speed by 0.2 m/sec.
[/list]
 
[b]Changed upgrades:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #9-3: "Reduced damage reflected while the ability is active. Reduced incoming damage from bullets and explosions by 60%" changed to "While the ability is active, allies within the area of effect take reduced incoming damage. The operator is immobilized. Incoming damage: -20% Area of effect: 4 m Effect duration: -6 sec."[/list]

[b]Game designer's comment: [/b]This upgrade is intended to unlock the operator's team potential and coordination. Useful for defensive operations. To help you get a better understanding of the area of effect, we added a dome-like visual effect.
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #10-2: "Increased amount of magazines for primary weapon by 1" changed to "Increased base HP by 10."
[*] Upgrade #15-1: "Increased Basic Primary Reserve stock by 2" changed to "The operator is able to hip-fire in single-shot while the ability is active. Rate of fire: -80% Spread: +200%."
[/list]
 
[b]Game designer's comment: [/b]The operator is well protected and reflects damage while the ability is active, so this upgrade should further increase their shooting potential. Combined with the new upgrade #9-3, it will allow the player to lay down fire and protect their allies at the same time.
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #15-3: "Basic Secondary Reserve stock increase: +2" changed to "Reduced incoming damage from explosions when using special gear by 25%."
[/list]
 
[b]Removed upgrades:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #13-2: "Base HP Increased by 10" moved to slot #10-2.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/a6755da813093bc8ffc2c6f2e0713fb4e45cbeef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/78d02869ca44a70c08c806f67135286dc0fa4e3f.jpg[/img]

[b]Medic Velour[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/23841e44e1397d8aeb7de20779625e123f7d52ef.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Primary weapon:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Reduced reticle size.
[/list]
 
[b]Game designer's comment:[/b] A smaller reticle allows for more accurate shooting, especially in combination with related skills and upgrades.
 
[list]
[*] Linear upgrade #10: Suppressor increases shooting range by 3 m.
[*] Added linear upgrade #9: New ammo: subsonic. Primary weapon recoil reduced by 15%, effective range reduced by 8 m.
[/list]
 
[b]Game designer's comment:[/b] Subsonic rounds allow for more accurate shooting, making Velour much more effective at both medium and close range.
 
[h2]REVAMPED UPGRADES[/h2]
 
New upgrades:
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #6-3: The operator revives allies faster in smoke. Revival speed: +50%
[*] Upgrade #11-2: The operator can use the ability while incapacitated. Can only be used once after going into incapacitated state.
[*] Upgrade #13-3: Medication and armor plates bag additionally reduces reserve cooldown by 25 sec.
[*] Upgrade #14-3: Additional magazine for your primary weapon: +1.
[*]Upgrade #15-3: When a medication and armor plate bag is picked up, restores ally HP within the area of effect. Area of effect: 5 m Healing: -7 HP.
[/list]

[b]Game designer's comment:[/b] Upgrade #15-3 allows for healing allies from a distance without them having to interact with the bag. Bonuses like additional Armor, Stamina replenishment, and reserve cooldown are only granted to the player who picked up the bag.
 
[b]Changed upgrades:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #2-1: "Basic Secondary Reserve stock increase: +2" changed to "Increased base Stamina by 50 SP."
[*] Upgrade #13-2: "Increased base Stamina by 75 SP" changed to "Medication and armor plates bag additionally restores Stamina by 75 SP."
[*] Upgrade #14-1: "Base HP increase: +10" changed to "Increased special gear ammo: +1."
[*] Upgrade #14-2: Increased base Stamina by 150 SP. (instead of 100)
[*] Upgrade #15-1: "Increased special gear ammo: +1" changed to "Base HP increase: +10."
[/list]
 
[b]Removed upgrades:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #2-3: Basic Secondary Reserve stock increase: +2.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/c7b75f92d03f9c8629f88abe50f21fe9ab618f86.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/ef160208454bc81efcf7cb764d4c594020956515.jpg[/img]

[b]Marksman Vagabond[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/34e30e904f4c9556ff1eee492cf141b897542917.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]REVAMPED UPGRADES[/h2]
 
[b]New upgrades:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #2-2 Increased shrapnel blast radius when using the ability: +1 m.
[*] Upgrade #5-2: The operator can use the ability with their secondary weapon. The area of effect and ability damage with the secondary weapon are permanent. Area of effect: 3 m Shrapnel damage: -60%.
[/list]
 
[b]Game designer's comment:[/b] Using a revolver in combination with the ability allows Vagabond to deal AoE damage. This is especially useful indoors and in narrow passages.
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #7-2: Increased base Stamina by 50 SP.
[*] Upgrade #7-3: Increased base Sprint speed by 0.3.
[*] Upgrade #9-3: AP ammo: +5% armor penetration.
[/list]
 
[b]Game designer's comment:[/b] Vagabond’s primary weapon among the lowest armor penetration of marksmen using bolt-action rifles. The new upgrade #9-3 fixes that.
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #11-3: Drone upgrade. Stunned frequency: +15%
[*] Upgrade #12-3: Increased base Stamina by 75 SP.
[*] Upgrade #15-3: The ability area of effect is increased but shrapnel damage is reduced. Area of effect: 4 m Shrapnel damage: -20%.
[/list]
 
[b]Changed upgrades:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Upgrade #2-1: "Increased base Stamina by 25 SP" changed to "Special gear search radius increased by 10 m."
[*] Upgrade #11-2: "Increased base Stamina by 50 SP" changed to "Increased drone Movement speed by 12%."
[*] Upgrade #12-2: "Increased area of effect of shrapnel blast from the ability: +4 m" changed to "The area of effect is increased but shrapnel damage is reduced. Area of effect: 3 m Shrapnel damage -10%/"
[*] Upgrade #15-2: "Increased base Stamina by 75 SP" changed to "Increased primary weapon armor penetration while the ability is active. Reduced shrapnel damage. Armor penetration: +10 Shrapnel damage -40%."
[/list]
 
[b]Game designer's comment:[/b] Another armor penetration improvement for Vagabond. Combined with the new upgrade #9-3 and Armor-piercing rounds skill, it significantly increases primary weapon armor penetration. To maintain balance, this upgrade only increases armor penetration while the operator’s ability is active, and it also significantly reduces shrapnel damage from the ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/5ecb27d19ab57a8edfaf48436d5c3ad87c874074.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/8c6362d1a0ffe52e3608c4ea8ac6f49c04ec7fa0.jpg[/img]


[h1]BOTS: OPERATOR INVISIBILITY[/h1]
 
The Invisible effect is currently effective only against other players. We decided to make it work when fighting against bots, too.
 
[h2]INVISIBILITY EFFECT EXPLAINED[/h2]
 
[b]Bots cannot see you:[/b]

[list]
[*] As long as you’re 10 m away or further.
[*] When you’re using reserves.
[*] When you’re not attacking (this does not include mines and drones).
[/list]

[b]Bots can see you:[/b]

[list]
[*] When you’re in range.
[*] When you attack.
[*] When the effect ends.
[*] When you interact with objects on the map (use Ammo boxes, capture servers, plant bombs on AA systems, etc.)
[*] When you begin to revive an ally.
[*] Being detected by a bot does not cancel the Invisible effect, and enemy players still won’t be able to see your mark and outline.
[/list]
 

[h1]BOTS: TAKING MORE DAMAGE[/h1]
 
Operators’ abilities and special gear are now more effective against bots.
 
[b]Regular bots:[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased incoming damage from explosions, fire, gas, bleeding, and knife by 100%.
[/list]
 
[b]Bot Officers (except for Heavy Fighters):[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased incoming damage from explosions, fire, gas, bleeding, and knife by 50%.
[/list]


[h1]CROUCH AND SHOOT[/h1]
 
Take a more comfortable position by crouching. Both spread and recoil will be reduced by 20% while aiming.

notes.title: Clans: First Details
notes.content:
Clans are coming to Caliber's next version. Here are the first details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/934c93d26f90036e56b58e86dd81f8ff5e668c62.png[/img]

1. Anyone will be able to create clans.
2. The first clan levels will be available for purchase with Credits as well as Coins. After reaching a certain clan level, next levels may be reached only with Coins. 
3. Every level opens more slots for players.
4. In clans, player activity will be one of the main efficiency measures. Playing with other clan members is more lucrative than your basic game activity.
5. A clan leader can assign predetermined roles which have different features. In the future, we may add a more flexible role setting system. 
6. Clan development is based on iterations. After the release, we will monitor player feedback and make necessary corrections.

We will share all details in a separate article a bit later.

What will be the name of your clan? Please share with us in the comments!

«This is a hobby from childhood: while attending an arts study group, I enjoyed drawing various pieces of equipment and soldiers as well as creating something on a free topic whenever possible. Nowadays, while playing video games (old as well as modern ones), I enjoy both what happens on the screen during gameplay, and the fact that screenshots can capture unusual moments, battles, spectacular hand-to-hand combats, and aesthetics of military equipment. When you really love the game, you want the time you have spent in it and the emotions you have experienced there to remain not only in your memory, so taking screenshots is a good way to achieve it. notes.title: Update 0.23.2: patch note
notes.content:
Update 0.23.2 is Available!

New content: The Rough 90s Battle Pass with the Vega Legendary Outfits for the Vympel collection, a new map Spaceport, updates for Threshold mode, a new operator rebalance, a number of bug fixes and more.

You can find the complete list of changes in our patch note.

[h2]GENERAL CHANGES[/h2]


[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/958/the-rough-90s-battle-pass-manual/]Added The Rough 90s Battle Pass.[/url]
[*] Added Vega Legendary Outfits for the Vympel collection.
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/953/spaceport-map-features-screenshots-and-video/]Added the Spaceport map to Threshold, Showdown, Hacking, Annihilation, and Onslaught modes.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/950/threshold-mode-big-rebalance-and-tutorial/]Added major balance changes to Threshold mode. [/url]
[*] Tutorials: added a tutorial mission for Threshold mode.
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/947/onslaught-mode-two-new-maps-and-improvements/]Onslaught mode: two new maps and improvements.[/url]
[*] Settings: added an option to assign the alternate use of an ability to a dedicated key with a single press. Previously, alternate activation was only possible by pressing and holding down the main activation key.
[*] Settings: added brightness and gamma options.
[*] Settings: added color and opacity crosshair options (hip-fire mode).
[*] Field Bonuses: it will now be possible to pick up a new Field Bonus without having an empty Field Bonus slot. Upon picking up a new bonus, the unused one will be automatically dropped.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused discounted outfit prices in the in-game Store Showcase to not always be correctly reflected in the operator Customization window.
[*] User Battles: the pause window was moved further up so it wouldn’t cover the player’s respawn timer.
[*] Contacts window: fixed a bug that caused internal strings to be displayed if (B) was entered in the search field.
[*] Fixed UI issues in the player report window.
[*] Improved the Battle Statistics screen: all elements now have a uniform style.
[*] Ranked Battles leaderboards: added an option to view player profiles.
[*] Referral Program window: fixed a bug that prevented the window from closing when clicking outside of it.
[*] Replays: fixed a bug that prevented player account levels from being displayed in the stats window (TAB).
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented enemy mines from being tagged with (C).
[*] Replays: fixed a bug that caused the announcer’s voice lines to replay from the beginning when rewinding the recording.
[*] Annihilation mode: fixed a bug that caused internal strings to be displayed when the match ended in a draw.
[*] Bipod: fixed a bug that caused the lower vignette to flicker.


[h2]OPERATORS[/h2]

[b][url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/956/re-balance-update-0-23-2/]Check out a detailed description of all operator changes in a separate article: RE: Balance.[/url][/b]

[list]
[*] Red Mist Emote: fixed a bug that caused the emote’s VFX to be displayed after its animation had been canceled.
[*] Precautionary Measures Emote: fixed a bug that caused the shot VFX to be displayed incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the reticle to become too bright under specific map lighting.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented operators from automatically switching to another weapon after running out of special gear ammo.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented items from being displayed when previewing emotes and executions.
[/list]

notes.title: Deathless. Tales of Old Rus Launches Into Steam Early Access
notes.content:
Discover the world of Belosvet in Deathless. Tales of Old Rus. Set out on an epic journey with heroes inspired by Slavic folklore, experience their stories, and eventually save your homeland from an invasion by Koschey the Deathless.

[previewyoutube=dq0J9rMKtr8;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2727210/_/

In the complete version of Deathless. Tales of Old Rus four heroes will be available. While starting the EA you play Varvara The Fair, crafty and cunning in equal measure, the treasure hunter wields her trusty pickaxe and enchanted braid in battle. Two additional heroes will be introduced during the EA period.
No two journeys in Deathless. Tales of Old Rus are the same, as the game features deep strategic variety, combat modifiers, and exciting secrets to uncover.

Deathless. Tales of Old Rus inspired by games like Slay the Spire is set in Belosvet, a fantasy world home to bogatyrs, wizards, and sorcerers, amusing little spirits known as nechistiks, and myriad creatures most foul. The world of Belosvet is inspired by Slavic folklore and has been carefully and lovingly redesigned by artist and author Roman Papsuev, the best artist of Europe in 2008 according to the Eurocon convention.

The game also features music from leading composer Dmitri Silantyev, who is known for his work on Pathfinder: Kingmaker, Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous, Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, Armored Warfare, and Skyforge.

[b]Game Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] A Whole New World: The first video game adaptation of the original universe by artist Roman Papsuev and featuring music by acclaimed composer Dmitriy Silantyev.
[*] Fearsome Fairytale Foes: Clash with revenants and khuds, fight a yaga, chat with a vodyanoy, and even befriend rusalkas… or maybe not — those sneaky water nymphs are deadly foes.
[*] Play Again and Again: Highly replayable gameplay complete with combat modifiers and strategic variety.
[*] Triumphant victory or crushing defeat?: Unlock new cards and battle modifiers by the end of each playthrough to make your future runs even more exciting.
[*] A unique path for each hero: Watch as the heroes’ tales intertwine in surprising ways. Complete quests, meet memorable allies, and confront inimitable foes. Defeating bosses will prove to be quite the challenge.
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/a156ed80336dadd7c8ab6a8dd930fd26b72e7a02.jpg[/img]

A fast Adrenaline mode is coming to this week’s Weekend mode category.
 
Adrenaline is based on the Showdown rules, but it has its own features:
 
• Stamina recovery speed is increased to 160 SP/sec.
• Sprinting cost is increased to 45 SP/sec.
• Ability activation does not waste Stamina.
• Stamina is recovering while the ability is active.
• After activating the ability or taking damage, Stamina will start to recover after 3 sec.
• After Sprinting has ended, Stamina will start to recover after 1 sec.
 
Before entering a battle, we recommend you to update your skill set.

notes.title: Update 0.23.1: patch note
notes.content:
Main changes: Not a Step Back Common Cause Event started, Defense mode added, Skirmish mode added to User Battles, the Hylan Legendary Outfits for the Jiaolong collection became available for purchase, fixed a number of bugs and more.

You can find the complete list of changes in our patch note.

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/919/not-a-step-back-common-cause/]Not a Step Back Common Cause Event started.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/920/defense-mode-rules-and-features/]Added Defense mode.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/920/defense-mode-rules-and-features/]Added Skirmish mode to User Battles.[/url]
[*] Hylan Legendary Outfits (Jiaolong): exclusivity period has ended. The outfits can now be purchased in the game client and on the official site.
[*] Combat hint screen [F1]: fixed a bug that prevented operator Revival Kits from being displayed.
[*] Command wheel (C) fixed a bug where opening the command wheel would interrupt interactions, such as revival, hacking, interaction with an ammo box, etc.
[*] Replays: fixed a bug that caused the player's UI to be displayed in free camera mode.
[*] User Battles: fixed a bug that caused the muted sound icon to be displayed next to the players of the opposing team.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the booster dropdown menu from closing.
[*] Battle Statistics: fixed a bug that prevented penalties from being displayed.
[*] Onslaught mode — Bots: Always visible modifier: fixed a bug that prevented the Marked effect from being inflicted on Gunner and Chemist bots.
[*] User Battles: fixed a bug that made it impossible to return to battle after leaving it during a pause.
[*] Mode selection window: fixed a bug that caused Premium to always be displayed as inactive in the Reward for victory window block.
[*] User Battles: Spectator — Threshold, and Frontline modes: fixed a bug that prevented the orange team's reserves from being displayed during loading.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused reserve icons to flash when spectating an ally. The bug occurred when the spectating player used hotkeys.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the mark for HP loss while jumping to be displayed in pink.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the spectating player to open an ally's command wheel, which was visible only to the spectator.
[*] Settings: fixed a bug that caused the [F9] key to not have a description.
[*] Battle Statistics: fixed a bug that caused the extra XP reward for choosing all modes in a category to be displayed incorrectly.
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/925/new-addition-to-army-surplus-container-version-0-23-1/]Added new goods to Army Surplus Containers.[/url]
[/list]

[h1]OPERATORS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug related to weapon position during several Executions.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the concussion sound from players' own grenades from playing.
[*] User Battles: pause: fixed a bug that caused several operators’ dynamic objects to be displayed incorrectly during pause.
[*] Execution window: fixed a bug that allowed a fireteam operator to be visible on-screen while viewing Executions. The bug appeared on high-resolution monitors (3440×1440).
[*] First-person view: fixed incorrect position/size of the primary weapon for Shàowèi, Starkaðr, Bishop, and Corsair.
[*] First-person view: fixed a bug that disabled special gear deployment animations for several operators.
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.23.0: patch note
notes.content:
In the update 0.23.0, we reworked the mode selection window, launched the Mean Joke event, added Player Referral Program, rebalanced some operators, fixed a number of errors and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/87ba8d91455f9fb14073d894385252402947097c.jpg[/img]

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/887/modes-a-new-way-of-selecting-and-weekend-mode/]Completely reworked the mode selection window: new design, new way of selecting, and Weekend mode.[/url]
[*] Rebalanced Daily and Weekly Objectives in accordance with the new mode selection feature.
[*] Deactivated the Special Operation mode objective.
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/877/user-battles-tournament-modes-and-pausing/]User Battles: added the ability to pause the game during matches, added Tournament versions of Hacking and Threshold.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/882/mean-joke-event/]Mean Joke Event started.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/878/player-referral-program/]Player Referral Program added.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/866/threshold-mode-adjustments-safety-around-the-hq/]Threshold mode improvements: automatic elimination when near the enemy base, and protection against projectiles and grenades.[/url]
[*] Hacking mode: added automatic elimination when a player manages to leave the infiltration area before the round preparation stage is over.
[*] Added new vignettes for the Shielded and Invulnerability effects.
[*] Settings: added the ability to set the HQ and battle framerate separately.
[*] Player statistics: previously opened tabs now remain on the screen.
[*] Added a blinking effect to the Caliber icon that signals a change in battle preparation stages. It appears if the player minimizes the game window.
[*] Containers: added a counter displaying the remaining containers while opening them.
[*] The Sing-song, Accordion, and Listen to this tune! Emotes: added looping music and animations.
[*] User Battles: fixed a bug that displayed the objective when the [ESC] button was pressed.
[*] Battle Statistics: fixed a bug that prevented the Least Deaths stats from being highlighted in yellow.
[*] Currency Conversion screen: fixed blurry icons.
[*] HQ: fixed a bug that prevented the yellow frame on the Battle Pass button from appearing when clicked.
[*] The infinite Combat Pay objective is now indicated in every window it appears in.
[*] Player statistics: fixed a bug that caused an incorrect number of medals to appear: 92 instead of 90.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused reserves' icons to be incorrectly colored.
[*] The Gymnastics Emote: fixed a bug that caused the operator's shoulders to move unnaturally.
[*] Fixed an incorrect visual effect on grenade explosions that sometimes appeared on the Hospital and Caravanserai maps.
[/list]

[h1]OPERATORS[/h1]

[h2]Check out a detailed description of the operator changes in a separate article: [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/879/re-balance-update-0-23-0/]RE: Balance.[/url][/h2]

[b]General changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Bots now attack robots and turrets that shoot them, instead of attacking the operators who deployed them.
[*] Incapacitated state: the camera is now the same as that of an active operator.
[*] Added the throwing animation for Field Bonuses, Intel, etc.
[*] The animations will now be more smooth at 120 frames per second and above.
[*] Added new voice lines when activating the abilities of operators that have EMP, Slowed, Suppressed, Marked, Invisible, and Shielded effects.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused opening the command quick menu © to interrupt active revival, hacking, interaction with an ammo box, etc.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused special gear animations and sounds to play incorrectly while underwater.
[*] Adrenaline Buzz skill: fixed a bug that caused the skill to work incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the Gas vignette from appearing if Volumetric Lighting was disabled in settings.
[*] Combat hint (F1): fixed a bug that caused the incorrect special gear characteristics to appear in the description, including damage, armor penetration, and ammo.
[*] Mustang, Monk, Schatz, Yàowáng, Kaval: improved 3D scopes. The bullets could previously fly a little over the reticle.
[*] Replays: fixed a bug that caused the checkmark icon to be displayed instead of operator levels.
[*] Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that caused the technical icon to be displayed in an operator’s effects list.
[*] R&R skill: fixed a bug that prevented the skill from providing immunity to Caçador’s area trap.
[/list]

[b]Volk, Vympel[/b]

[list]
[*] Claw and Leader Epic Outfits: fixed a bug that caused the secondary weapon to be attached to the belt instead of the holster.
[*] Iron Grip ability: fixed a bug that prevented the Suppressed effect from increasing weapon spread while the ability is active.
[/list]

[b]Strelok, Vympel[/b]

[list]
[*] Primary weapon: decreased the grip texture’s brightness to improve camo display.
[/list]

[b]Kit, 22 SpN[/b]

[list]
[*] Linear upgrade #14 "Shortened barrel. Reduces the number of shots required to gain immunity to the Stunned effect." The number of shots required to gain immunity is decreased by 1. The upgrade previously needed exactly 4 shots to activate, which conflicted with the #13-1 and #8-2 upgrades.
[/list]

[b]Bourbon, SEAL[/b]

[list]
[*] Patriot Legendary Outfit: fixed a bug that prevented the weapon’s model from changing when switching scopes while in the HQ.
[/list]

[h2]CST[/h2]

[b]General changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Liberty Legendary Outfit: corrected several animations. Namely, fixed incorrect neck positions when Sly holds a grenade and when Fortress holds an Incendiary Ammo Box.
[/list]

[b]Sly, CST[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Sly’s finger to clip through the front sight of the primary weapon while in HQ.
[/list]

[b]Fortress, CST[/b]

[list]
[*] Liberty Legendary Outfit, primary weapon: moved the sight on the weapon model, which was previously off-center.
[/list]

[b]Bones, CST[/b]

[list]
[*] Buddy special gear: fixed bugs during the robot’s deployment animation.
[/list]

[b]Miguel, EZAPAC[/b]

[list]
[*] Medical Drone ability: improved the movement system. The drone is now able to fly over obstacles, including vertical ones, but only in places where bots can pass.
[/list]

[b]Diablo, EZAPAC[/b]

[list]
[*] Inferno ability: fixed a bug that caused the target to burn for a shorter amount of time than intended after hitting them with a body shot. The bug appeared when upgrade #15-2 was active.
[/list]

[b]Tibet, Arystan[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an incorrect primary weapon icon.
[/list]

[b]Busel, SSO RB[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the operator’s hand to clip through the primary weapon.
[/list]

[b]Martelo, BOPE[/b]

[list]
[*] Ram special gear: fixed the incorrect position of the ram while climbing over obstacles, replenishing ammo, and switching equipment.
[/list]

[b]Açaí，BOPE[/b]

[list]
[*] Pit Viper Epic Outfit: fixed incorrect position of a chevron on the beret.
[/list]

[h2]SAS[/h2]

[b]General changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Onslaught mode, Medkit Field Bonus: fixed a bug that caused operators to pull out their secondary weapons instead of self-reviving while incapacitated.
[*] Now, a single press of the [E] key pulls out the secondary weapon. If an operator can self-revive, like in the above example, the [E] key should be pressed and held down instead.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the special trait activation voice line to be audible across the entire map.
[/list]

[b]Lumen, SAS[/b]

[list]
[*] Blinded ability: fixed a bug that disabled the ability’s sound effect if the player removed the reticle from the target, then moved it back again.
[/list]

[b]Tower, SAS[/b]

[list]
[*] Upgrades #15-1 and #15-3: fixed a bug that prevented the Inspired effect icon from appearing.
[/list]

[b]Spark, SAS[/b]

[list]
[*] Upgrade #12: fixed a bug that caused incorrect effect icons to appear.
[/list]

[b]Bell, SAS[/b]

[list]
[*] On the ground! ability: fixed a bug that prevented the EMP from cancelling Aphela and Starkaðr’s ability effects.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the operator to fire their primary weapon after interacting with an ammo box.
[/list]

[h1]MAPS, MODES AND BOTS[/h1]

[b]General changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Threshold Mode: added a 10-second delay after picking up intel. The delay will not activate if the player carrying the intel gets eliminated and another player picks it up.
[*] Annihilation Mode: fixed a bug that caused several players to get the Field Bonus from the container simultaneously.
[*] Showdown mode: corrected the draw requirements. If a round ends in a draw, both teams receive a winning point. The battle will end when the required number of victories is reached.
[*] Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that prevented players from walking through destroyed bot drones.
[*] Threshold Mode: fixed a bug that sometimes caused the Field Bonus to disappear after the operator carrying it was eliminated.
[*] User Battles, Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that prevented the "Bots: Always visible" modifier from working.
[*] User Battles, Spectator: fixed a bug that prevented hotkeys from being blocked while using the chat.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Chemist bot to pick drones, turrets, and items thrown on the ground as primary targets.
[*] Practice mode: fixed a bug that caused the mannequin’s pistol model to change after being stunned or eliminated.
[*] Threshold mode: area capture progress is now reset if only an enemy operator is present in the area. If operators of both teams are present in the area, the progress is paused.
[*] Onslaught mode, Ambush modifier: fixed a bug that prevented key bots’ marks from appearing.
[*] Threshold Mode: fixed a bug that allowed a bomb dropped on the map to be rigged by the enemy team, then reappear at the base with the mine attached.
[*] Prologue: Support: fixed a bug that allowed bot Sztylet to walk through closed gates.
[*] Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that caused bots guarding the drone to run away from it.
[*] Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that prevented bot drones from dealing any damage when exploding.
[*] Prologue mode: fixed a bug that caused an invisible object to spawn in the parking lot and block the way through.
[*] Prologue mode: fixed incorrect jumping off objects in the parking lot.
[*] Onslaught mode: fixed Dispatch’s incorrect voice line during the victory cutscene.
[/list]

[h2]SHOPPING MALL[/h2]

[b]PvE Version[/b]

[list]
[*] Point Sweep and Special Operation modes: fixed a bug that allowed entering a closed-off area prematurely.
[/list]

[h2]CARAVANSERAI[/h2]

[b]PvE Version[/b]

[list]
[*] Point Sweep and Special Operation modes: fixed a bug that prevented the laptop model from appearing during the laptop installation animation.
[/list]

[h2]EMIR RESIDENCE[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved nav mesh for robots and drones. There existed spots on the map where, while technically passable by robots and drones, they could not do so.
[/list]

[h2]HOSPITAL[/h2]

[b]General changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a number of spots where operators could not pass because of invisible obstacles.
[*] Replays: fixed a bug that caused the player to go out of bounds while in free camera Mode.

notes.title: Threshold mode adjustments: safety around the HQ
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! The next version is 0.23.0!
 
First, we’d like to share some news on adjustments to Threshold mode. Last time, we improved the UI. Now we’re making changes to fix one nasty issue.
 
We know from your feedback that APC alone is not enough to defend the base. Players have discovered ways to eliminate enemies close to their HQ.
 
With update 0.23.0, the base will become much safer.

[previewyoutube=ADS8nQC7cWc;full][/previewyoutube]
 
1. When an enemy gets too close to your base, their screen will turn black and white, and a warning will appear advising them to stay away. Five seconds later, the enemy operator will be automatically eliminated.

2. Also, enemies won’t be able to fire shells or throw grenades at the area around your HQ. Please note that the area around your HQ is smaller than that of the base. Shell protection is provided around the area where you deliver intel.

notes.title: Update 0.22.2: patch note
notes.content:
The 0.22.2 update has been released. We added the Spring Break Battle Pass with the Liberty Legendary Outfits, conducted an operator rebalance, updated the Onslaught mode, replaced all remaining 2D scopes with their 3D versions, fixed a number of issues and more.

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/832/the-spring-break-battle-pass-manual/]Added the Spring Break Battle Pass.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/829/onslaught-reworks-new-rounds-and-modifiers/]Updated Onslaught mode.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/828/telescopic-3d-scopes/]Added 129 3D sights.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/818/depot-map-in-threshold-mode/]Added the Depot map to Threshold mode.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/824/combat-hint-screen-rework/]Reworked the Combat hint screen.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/820/threshold-mode-ui-improvements/]Improved the UI in Threshold mode.[/url]
[*] Added an option to select or disable an XP booster during the battle preparation stage.
[*] Added a new window that displays the contents of Containers: it displays the list of goods that have a chance of appearing in it.
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/812/new-content-for-army-surplus-container-version-0-22-2/]Added new goods to Army Surplus Containers.[/url]
[*] Fixed a known bug that caused memory leak.
[*] Improved visual effects for impacts on sand and snow.
[*] Improved explosion effects for incendiary grenades.
[*] Added new visual effects for gas.
[*] Car with bots: Improved the way the car stops after the driver bot is eliminated.
[*] User Battles: Threshold, spectator mode: Fixed a bug that caused markers to be incorrectly colored for the spectator.
[*] Battle Statistics: Fixed a bug that caused incorrect rewards (XP) to be displayed on medals.
[*] Player stats: Fixed a bug that caused internal strings to be displayed for some players in the Ranked Leagues section.
[*] Cold Welcome Execution: Fixed visual issues.
[*] Brute Force Execution: Fixed visual issues.
[*] Forgot the Keys Emote: Fixed visual issues.
[*] Red Mist Emote: Fixed incorrect position of the flare on the ground.
[*] Cool Your Jets Emote: Fixed an issue that caused the operator’s arm to be positioned unnaturally.
[*] Nothing Personal Execution: Fixed an issue that caused the weapon to display incorrectly at the end of the execution animation.
[*] Showdown mode, UI: Fixed an issue that prevented information about victory/defeat from being displayed if the player was spectating a teammate at the time.
[*] Fixed a number of typos.
[*] Nesher, Superiority Execution: Fixed the operator’s wrist bending unnaturally during the animation.
[/list]

[h3]Check out a detailed description of the operator changes in a separate article: [url=https://playcaliber.com/ru/news/833/re-balans-obnovlenie-0-22-2/]RE: Balance.[/url][/h3]

[*] Refined Formula skill: Fixed a typo in the skill’s description. At maximum level, the skill restores 150 SP, not 160 as previously stated in the description.
[*] Combat Reserves: Fixed a bug that caused an incorrect number of reserves to display on the operator’s screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Threshold mode: UI improvements
notes.content:
We continue our work to improve Threshold mode. 

In version 0.22.0 you’ll see not only the new Depot map, but also some improvements to the UI. 

We plan to make the UI more informative and intuitive, which should have a positive impact on gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/9994c7c36705341e6f4ccd3ed6fbd9dbb8533617.jpg[/img]

1. Respawn timers will now be displayed next to the list of eliminated operators on the side panels. You will be able to see the respawn times for both your and enemy teammates. Use this information to better plan your tactics.

2. The information about planting explosives on AA systems will now also be displayed in the top panel, so the most important data is always easily visible.

3. An icon will be displayed on the side panel next to the portrait of the teammate who is carrying a bomb.

4. We’ve also made some changes and improvements to the Spectator UI.

Our efforts to improve the UI don’t end here. We plan to make it even better in future versions, so that planning your tactics and spectating matches can become ever more convenient.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.22.1
notes.content:
During scheduled maintenance of Caliber servers, we implemented a number of changes and fixes to the game.

Ranked Season 9: Encased in Ice has started. Added the Radar map to the Frontline and Threshold modes; fixed some bugs.

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Ranked Season 9: Encased in Ice has started.
[*] Caliber+: fixed a bug that prevented access to User Battles.
[*] Player Statistics: fixed a bug that tallied up Practice and Prologue modes in statistics.
[*] Player Statistics: fixed a bug that caused the "Total time in battles" statistic to be displayed incorrectly.
[*] Player Statistics: fixed a bug that caused the "Max. Eliminations (players)" statistic to be displayed incorrectly.
[*] No Mercy Execution: fixed the asynchronous sound while shooting.
[*] Cold Welcome Execution: fixed several visual errors.
[*] Crackling and Nothing personal Executions: added the missing banners.
[*] Living Legend Emblem: rarity type upgraded to Legendary.
[*] Red Mist Emote: rarity type upgraded to Rare.
[*] Annihilation mode, Brute Force Execution: fixed a bug that prevented the points from being awarded and the penalty from being applied.
[*] Annihilation mode, No Mercy Execution: fixed a bug that cause the game client to freeze.
[/list]

[h1]OPERATORS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Marksman Komar, primary weapon: increased body damage. It is now 61 instead of 60.
[/list]

[i][b]Game designer’s comment:[/b] we fixed the situation where two shots at an enemy who had 100 HP and 20 AP lowered their HP to 0, but did not eliminate them. This was caused by the rounding of numbers.[/i]

[list]
[*] Medic Miguel, improvement No. 10 has been returned to its previous form: the hitscan has been removed, the random displacement of the central pellet has been returned, the drop of pellets at a distance has been returned, the reduction in the speed of pellets with an active improvement has been returned. The damage reduction indicator remained unchanged.
[*] Support Tower, ARWEN-37 special gear: fixed a bug that prevented the Concussed visual effects from working if the player disabled the "Volumetric lights" option.
[*] Assault Mustang, Hazmat Epic Outfit: increased the reticle size of the primary weapon’s collimator sight. Also fixed a bug that caused another rifle to appear on the operator’s back after equipping the special gear.
[*] Medic Spark: updated the description of upgrade #15-1 to add the information about projectiles.
[*] Marksman Bell: updated the description of his special gear to add the information about his job.
[*] Medic Spark and Support Tower: fixed a bug that caused the equipment to float in the air.
[*] Medic Travnik, Healer Epic Outfit: fixed a bug that sometimes caused the primary weapon to float in the air.
[*] Assault Aphela, Medic Shersheret, Assault Perun and Support Svarog: fixed several bugs related to primary weapon reticles.
[*] SAS operators, Annihilation mode: fixed a bug that prevented the five-second timer before operators could be revived from appearing.
[*] Medic Spark: fixed a bug that caused the ability voice lines to be audible across the entire map.
[*] Support Tower: fixed a bug that caused the ability voice lines to be audible across the entire map.
[*] Marksman Bell, primary weapon’s basic reticle: corrected mouse sensitivity while aiming.
[*] Medic Mikołaj: fixed a bug that prevented the operator from picking up the Emergency Care.
[*] Marksman Scout: fixed a bug that prevented the operator from picking up the special gear.
[*] Assault Lumen, upgrade #12-1: fixed a bug that caused the Invisible effect’s icon to disappear too quickly while incapacitated.
[*] Support Hagana, Snowstorm Epic Outfit: fixed visual bugs related to the primary weapon’s reticle.
[*] Support Stern: fixed visual bugs related to the primary weapon’s reticle.
[*] Shooting Posture skill: fixed a bug that caused the effect icon to sometimes disappear even when the skill was still active.
[*] Lone Wolf skill: fixed a bug that caused the effect icon to sometimes disappear even when the skill was still active.
[*] Ambush skill: fixed a bug that prevented the Invisible effect from being removed.
[*] Healing Touch skill: fixed a bug that allowed the skill to affect all operators around the target.
[*] Support Tower, upgrade #14-1: fixed a bug that caused the actual healing bonus to be lower than listed in the description.
[/list]

[h1]MAPS, MODES AND BOTS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Radar map: added to Frontline and Threshold modes.
[*] Crossing map: fixed a bug that prevented the SAS operators from drowning.
[*] Al-Malik Hotel map, Frontline and Threshold modes: fixed several bugs in the opening cutscenes.
[*] User Battles, Frozen Town map: fixed bugs in Ranked Battles mode.
[*] Frozen Town map: fixed a bug that prevented the mini-map from being displayed while loading in several modes.
[*] Frozen Town map: fixed the cafe building’s collision.
[*] Crossing map, Ranked Battles mode: fixed several spots where climbing and jumping off objects worked incorrectly.
[*] Radar map, Point Sweep and Special Operation modes: removed the sniper bot from the helicopter.
[*] Radar map, Frontline and Threshold modes: fixed a bug that caused several invisible objects to appear on the map.
[*] Threshold, Heavy Fighter bot: fixed a bug that prevented the bomb detonation acceleration bonus from resetting after destroying the enemy’s AA systems.
[*] Radar map: fixed a bug that caused the echo in the new rooms to not match the size of the room.
[*] Prologue: fixed several bugs related to bot actions.
[*] Depot map, Onslaught mode: fixed a bug that caused the bomb model to be absent from the map.
[*] Depot map, Onslaught mode: added the Twilight lightning.
[*] Prologue: Medic: fixed several bugs that caused the game client to freeze and the bot animations to be displayed incorrectly.
[/list]

[b]Radar map, Point Sweep and Special Operation modes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the radar’s object model to disappear at the end of the mission.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed bots to pass through the control room’s window.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the hacking device install area to sometimes be displayed with a delay.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused operator models to clip through the elevator door.
[*] Fixed several cutscene bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Again About Twitch Drops
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/cedde89d2431f36bcc3e0491c65a609296a903e5.jpg[/img]

Yesterday, we launched Operation Snowfall, a new Twitch Drops season. You might have noticed that by watching the chosen channel, the progress bar was active only for one campaign. We have found out why this is happening.

When you enter a channel and see the Snowflakes picture in the technical chat, then you shall receive daily rewards. If you see the Snowstorm picture, then you shall receive unique rewards.

These are two different campaigns, and according to the rules of the platform, one cannot receive rewards of both campaigns from one channel.

If you are a streamer who wants to have a campaign with unique rewards, please write to us on Discord — badbishop.

notes.title: Update 0.22.1: patch note
notes.content:
The New Year version turned out to be large. We added the Knights of the Crown Battle Pass with SAS operators, Caliber+, player statistics, a new mission for the Radar map, a new map Frozen Town; conducted a rebalance of various maps and fixed a lot of bugs. And there’s more.

Learn more about the update from a patch note.

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/771/british-sas-collection/]Added the new SAS collection[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/776/the-knights-of-the-crown-battle-pass-manual/]Added the Knights of the Crown Battle Pass.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/store/caliber-plus/]Added Caliber+.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/753/player-statistics-manual/]Added player statistics.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/763/snowy-shop-new-year-showcase-and-daily-objectives/]Began the Snowy Shop event.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/764/twitch-drops-season-four-operation-snowfall/]Prepared the fourth season of Twitch Drops: Operation Snowfall.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/744/new-mission-on-radar/]Added a new mission on the Radar map.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/761/frozen-town-map-features-screenshots-and-videos/]Added the new Frozen Town map for Showdown, Annihilation and Ranked Battle (Hacking) modes.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/756/re-balance-update-0-22-1/]Carried out operator rebalancing. Added the new Weak Sprint mechanic.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/748/rebalancing-six-maps-in-pvp-modes/]Rebalanced six maps in PvP modes.[/url]
[*] Onslaught mode: fixed several errors in the final cutscenes.
[*] Changed some operators’ upgrade icons.
[*] Ranked Battle: fixed a bug that allowed entering the mode with one Level 10+ operator.
[*] Replays, gamepad controls: fixed a bug that prevented scrolling through lists in menus with the analog stick during a replay.
[*] Operator upgrades: corrected upgrade descriptions for some operators.
[*] All modes: fixed a bug that prevented the camera from automatically switching to an ally after the player had been executed.
[*] Ranked Battle: fixed a bug that prevented players from changing their choice during the Picks and Bans stage.
[*] Fixed incorrect visuals on the Winter HQ Background.
[/list]

Effects:

[list]
[*] Medic Travnik, primary weapon: decreased the amount of gunpowder clouds from shots.
[*] Onslaught mode, sapper robot: added the visual damage resistance effect.
[*] Green laser designators: fixed a bug that caused the aiming dot to display as a semi-circle.
[*] The Weapon of Victory HQ background: fixed a bug that caused the wrong lightning to appear on the HQ background.
[*] Onslaught and Annihilation modes: fixed a bug that prevented the indication of an activated Field Bonus.
[*] Fixed the incorrect display of operators’ XP gauges filling up on the Operators screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the visual effect of the incendiary cartridges to disappear.
[*] Replays. Fixed incorrect positions of some of the HUD elements.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to report themselves.
[/list]

[h1]OPERATORS[/h1]

Check out a detailed description of the operator changes in a separate article: [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/756/re-balance-update-0-22-1/]RE: Balance.[/url]

notes.title: Micro-rebalance: Avant-garde and Açaí
notes.content:
The latest rebalance of version 0.22.0 introduced many changes. Two of these were a significant buff for Assault Avant-garde and a significant nerf for Medic Açaí. This Wednesday, November 22, we will slightly tweak some of these operators' characteristics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/db136482c0bcd77e16de68b6ea38a76ef697c747.jpg[/img]

[b]1. Assault Avant-garde.[/b]
 
Players have learned to use Avant-garde as a long-distance fighter more efficiently than we anticipated. This was made possible by an improvement to linear upgrade #10.
 
We will slightly lower the primary weapon's rate of fire, and rebalance linear upgrade #10 itself. Now, the Longer Barrel upgrade will make the speed vs longer distance tradeoff more apparent. Avante-garde’s mobility will be gradually lowered, and not just while firing the primary weapon, and the slowdown will also last longer.

 We recommend using the Longer Barrel on suitable maps. The module can be turned on and off in the operator customization screen before a battle.
 
Primary weapon:
 
• Rate of fire reduced from 4 to 3.75 shots per second (it was 3.5 before the 0.22.0 update).
 
Linear upgrade #10 “Longer Barrel: Increased effective firing range”:
 
• Stability bonus decreased from 15% to 7%.
• "Movement speed reduced while using a rifle" changed to "Sprint speed and movement speed reduced by 0.5 m/s".
• Removed the movement speed decrease when firing the primary weapon while crouching.
 
 
[b]2. Medic Açaí.[/b]
 
One of the main traits of this Brazilian Medic is his increased healing. Our stats have shown that the nerf decreased Açaí's healing effectiveness by a greater extent than we anticipated.
 
• Pneumatic Ampoule Launcher special gear: base healing per hit on a teammate increased. It is now 6 HP per hit instead of 5.

notes.title: Update 0.22.0: patch note
notes.content:
Update 0.22.0 is available now!

We rebalanced operators, optimized and added 3D scopes for 42 characters, updated the battle HUD, added a Spectator mode for User Battles, fixed a number of bugs and performed other tweaks.

Enjoy playing the new version of Caliber!

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/704/3d-scopes-optimization-and-big-additions/]Optimized 3D scopes and added them for 42 operators.[/url]
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/710/version-0-22-0-interface-update/]Added new combat HUD.[/url]
[*] User Battles: [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/724/spectator-mode-manual/]Spectator mode added.[/url]
[*] Prestige: Reaching level 10 is now rewarded with the "Superiority" execution.
[*] [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/725/new-special-offers-in-update-0-22-0/]Updated most special offers,[/url] including their contents, pricing and the award process.
[*] Practice mode: Two "incapacitated" mannequins added to let players test executions and revivals.
[*] The term "ammunition load" has been replaced with "ammo" everywhere.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Marksman bots to not have a laser sight glint.
[*] Replays, Threshold mode: Fixed a bug that prevented the respawn tooltip from disappearing.
[*] "Stay Vigilant" and "The Way of the Fist" emotes: Fixed a bug that would cause the operator’s arm to clip into their pouches.
[*] Ammo box Team Reserve: Fixed a bug that caused the reloading animation to play after interacting with the box.
[*] Surrendering: Fixed a bug that caused typing "Y" in the chat to be recognized as a vote against.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed sergeant/officer bots to continue reloading after being incapacitated.
[*] User Battles: Fixed a bug that prevented player emblems from updating if they were changed while in the room.
[*] Threshold mode, Heavy Fighter bot: Fixed a bug that prevented damage from being dealt when hitting certain parts of the bot’s head.
[*] "Payback Time" and "Dashing Shooter" emotes: Rarity level raised to Rare.
[*] Added ribbons and medals for Threshold mode.
[*] Army Surplus Container: Added a guaranteed chance to receive an Epic Outfit. If you don’t receive an Epic Outfit after opening 69 containers, the 70th container will drop one with 100% probability.
[*] Ranked modes: Teams will now take turns selecting their bans during the ban stage. This will prevent situations where both teams ban the same operator.

notes.title: Spectator Mode Manual
notes.content:
As part of developing Caliber into a fully-fledged competitive esports title, a new Spectator mode will be added to the game. It will allow players to comfortably watch each other’s matches in User Battles. It was made possible, among other things, thanks to the HUD changes that we talked about recently.

Spectators will be able to see all information about both teams: their positions, markers, HP and Armor values, ability cooldowns, and more.

This new function will be made available in version 0.22.0.

[previewyoutube=paS9sV2_v-Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/724/spectator-mode-manual/]All the details are on the website.[/url]

notes.title: Maintenance underway
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/0107aee3f15098207a357e5cd0ce4d857f757dd0.jpg[/img]

On Wednesday, November 8, 7:30 AM UTC, scheduled technical maintenance will begin on the Caliber servers. During this period, the game will be unavailable.

Make sure to use the “Firecrackers!” and Party Sounds Emotes in your battles to complete Daily Objectives! Tomorrow, the event will end. The players who didn’t have these Emotes on their accounts before the event will no longer be able to use them.

See you all in Caliber version 0.22.0!

notes.title: New Special Offers in update 0.22.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/7dc725281b1ca8cb6b480bcb714f711af32c609b.jpg[/img]

Almost all in-game Special Offers will be changed in the 0.22.0 update!

The current Special Offers distribution system has been in use, unchanged, for quite some time. It doesn’t factor in your wishes or account stats at all and presents you offers that aren't interesting to you.

The new Special Offers distribution system will be much more individualized. It will take multiple variables into account: your preferred game mode, how often you play it, your favorite class, and more.

[url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/725/new-special-offers-in-update-0-22-0/]Learn more from an article on our website.[/url]

notes.title: RE: Balance changes — update 0.22.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
 
Since the latest operator balance changes in version 0.21.1, we have been closely listening to your feedback and analyzing match statistics. We’ve drawn some conclusions and noted your requests. Now, we’re finally ready to tell you what’s going to change in version 0.22.0.
 
We paid especially close attention to the feedback from high-ranking players of the current ranked season, Arctic Wind.
 
The short version is in the video. Check it out, Recruit did his best. The details are in this article.
 
[previewyoutube=VsyugimFIsU;full][/previewyoutube] 
 
 
[h1]HITSCAN[/h1] 

In the previous updates many operators received a buff in the form of instant bullets, also known as hitscan. But it eventually became apparent that, in deft hands, this makes certain operators TREMENDOUSLY more powerful than we’d initially thought.
 
For an average player, hitscan is just a slight buff. But for an experienced and talented player, it was huge.
 
Four operators are going to lose hitscan attacks in 0.22.0.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/a5189fff9a77489be025d24d46310897dfd33bc2.jpg[/img]
 
However, their bullet velocity will still be high, like that of Marksman Vagabond. The French marksman currently has the highest bullet velocity in the game (not counting the hitscan operators).
 


[h1]OPERATOR BALANCE CHANGES[/h1] 

[h2]VYMPEL[/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/6010061cc260b723767f396d6626856fabcd3113.jpg[/img]
 
[list]
[*] Healing ability: Self-healing (activated by holding [Q]) now takes 1 sec. instead of 2.3 sec.
[/list]

[h2]ALPHA[/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/ff959a68782c70dafb3307a2c40bcce1e5b4c68a.jpg[/img]
 
[list]
[*] Primary weapon body damage increased from 17 to 19.
[*] Suppressed ability: The description now states the exact number of hits required to inflict the effect on an enemy.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/d58519469ed52164a6f583c681683b7f4c5772bb.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Primary weapon reload time reduced from 3.1 sec. to 2.5 sec.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/590dd24c5f2a2f34514acf755b3b0efcfa6ec21c.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*] Modified upgrade #15-1 (“Incapacitating an opponent while the ability is active extends the duration of the ability by 3 seconds”): Now can only be triggered by eliminations with a headshot.
[*] Modified linear upgrade #10 (“Thermal tape: Delays the application of the Marked effect by 3.5 sec. when using Bullet Rain”): Activating the ability no longer applies the Marked effect, but the activation cost of the ability is increased by 50 SP.
[/olist]

[h2]SSO[/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/99e4217e67f9a8f1d9ea83c403278bae5905519a.jpg[/img]
 
[list]
[*] Primary weapon rate of fire increased from 8.8 to 9.3 shots per second.
[*] Preventative Action ability: Effective range increased by 15 m. Reduced the slowing effect applied to enemies with headshots from 90% to 50%.
[*] Upgrade #15-1: “Special trait: incapacitating an opponent affected by the ability restores Stamina” replaced with “Increases the amount of Stamina restored by the special trait”. Stamina recovery increased to 45 SP.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/641e0a25f8653767040910b4a9a75ccd341ceee9.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Primary weapon rate of fire increased from 8.5 to 9 shots per second.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/8fc9f9f870b3743f4270be44bbbcaee436434b17.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] The number of bursts for the primary weapon increased from 2.5 to 2.75.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/9b44f740b710739136f8189c5633cfa10717db27.jpg[/img]

[list]

[/list]
 
[h2]22 SPN[/h2]

We’ll be fulfilling the promise we made on our official Discord:

[/list]

[i][b]Game designer’s comment: [/b]If several incapacitated operators are nearby, the banner will prioritize reviving Medics. BUT if the banner has already started reviving a different operator (say, an Assault), and then a Medic enters its area of effect, the banner will continue reviving the Assault. The banner cannot switch targets mid-revive.[/i]

notes.title: Halloween Fan Art
notes.content:
Here comes a gorgeous Halloween inspired piece of fan art from Dofaminos! Looks good and has an idea, which is no less important. You haven’t seen operators in such Outfits yet.

This is what the author told us about their work:

[i]“I thought that it would be quite banal to create something with vampires or witches or other creatures, which are associated with Halloween. This is why my idea was to depict operators in the Outfits that represent creatures from the folklore of their home countries. It’s both cultural representation and Halloween atmosphere preservation.”[/i]
