notes.title: How we are fighting the cheaters
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/fc6d755a9abbd9e7a3c24faafb14208f971fcda9.jpg[/img]

Today, we want to share our methods of fighting cheaters in Caliber. This is a never-ending process that takes place every day. It’s happening even as you read this intro.
 
There is no anti-cheat that is capable of getting rid of cheaters completely. Nor is there a magic button that blocks all of them at once.
 
That is why we simultaneously use three methods of seeking out and punishing those who play dirty.

[url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/717/how-we-are-fighting-the-cheaters/]All the details are on our website.[/url]

notes.title: Ranked Battles: Operator Banning in Turns in 0.22.0
notes.content:
We will slightly change the operator banning stage in the Ranked Battles mode. Starting from the 0.22.0 update, operator banning will happen in turns. There will be no more situations when both teams ban the same operator.  

Teams will have 12 seconds for each ban. Team A (decided randomly) will be the first to ban operators and the second to pick them.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/e4482e108ce73ca51e46c96ea52b4e8bf72de17a.jpg[/img]

October 23 marks the anniversary of the RAID Unit!

As part of the celebration, players will be able to purchase bundles with the operators from the collection, Legendary Outfits, and XP boosters. 

The offer will be available to players of Account Level 15 and above. There are 4 bundles in total, and each of them will be available for purchase as long as you do not already have the operator and outfit on your account.

[olist]
[*] Assault Avant-garde, the Mercenary Legendary Outfit, 3 days of Premium and 2 XP Boosters.
[*] Support Bastion, the Mercenary Legendary Outfit, 3 days of Premium and 2 XP Boosters.
[*] Medic Velour, the Mercenary Legendary Outfit, 3 days of Premium and 2 XP Boosters.
[*] Marksman Vagabond, the Mercenary Legendary Outfit, 3 days of Premium and 2 XP Boosters.
[/olist]

The price of each bundle with a 40% discount: 4,900 Coins.

The bundles will be available for purchase under the Special Offers section in the game client between 8 AM UTC on October 23 and 8 AM UTC on October 25.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.21.1
notes.content:
During scheduled maintenance of Caliber servers, we implemented a number of changes and fixes to the game.

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Decreased the size of the Heavy Metal Battle Pass emblem on the store’s banner.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game client to freeze if the last operator standing died to a grenade explosion.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused operators to not be displayed during replays.
[*] Hello from Hong Kong Execution: removed excess blur.
[*] Stay Vigilant Emote: Reworked and improved performance.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the mode’s name and battle time from appearing on the battle stats screen.
[*] Ranked Battles: Fixed a bug that caused the lack of activity penalty message to stay on screen after reading it.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused operators’ markers to drift to one side.
[*] Gamepads: Fixed a bug that caused aim assist to work incorrectly and drift away from the target if aiming while moving.
[*] Gamepads: Added aim assist for Medics Miguel and Açaí’s Special gear.
[*] Gamepads: Fixed a bug that allowed players to move with an open Score screen (TAB).
[/list]

Threshold Mode:

[list]
[*] Added the Picks and Bans stage.
[*] To access the mode, players need to have at least three Level 10+ operators of the same role on their account.
[*] Friendly fire is enabled.
[*] The Recruits are unavailable.
[/list]

More on[url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/691/picks-and-bans-will-be-added-to-threshold-mode/] these changes.[/url]

notes.title: Important News for Threshold players!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/5dfd3c202169a0a2b631063354aaec0448f13e56.jpg[/img]

From September 27, new rules will come into effect in Threshold mode, and the rewards will be increased. A new Picks and Bans stage will now appear before the battle, which will allow players to pick their desired map and ban specific operators from the selection pool.

We want to see how well Picks and Bans work in Threshold mode, which operators will get banned the most, and which maps will be the most popular among players. During this period, the standard version of Threshold mode will be unavailable.

If you have access to User Battles, please use this opportunity to play Threshold mode and host various competitions. Don’t forget to share your impressions with us.

All the [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/691/picks-and-bans-will-be-added-to-threshold-mode/]details[/url] are on our website.

notes.title: Creative Contests for Caliber's Birthday!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/3c380aafc8180c576e2dfc8681ab0f8968f6609d.jpg[/img]

On October 29, Caliber will celebrate its fourth year since the OBT launch! To celebrate the game's birthday, we are announcing THREE creative contests.

1. The Masquerade is about creating a cosplay out of common household items.
2. The Doppelgänger is about creating a cosplay using professional equipment.
3. The Master of Editing is about creating a great video.

Each contest will have five prizes — different sums of Coins. The biggest prize awaits all three winners of each contest: apart from Coins, they will have their nicknames immortalized on a new map.

Dates of contests: from September 25 to October 25.

Pick a contest you like the most. Or participate in all of them!

Please make sure to read about [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/687/caliber-anniversary-creative-contests-rules-and-prizes/]Rules, Policies, and Rewards[/url] on our website.

However, it doesn’t mean that the version will be less interesting. Let us remind you that technical changes are related to enhancement or creation of new functionality, and are aimed for improving the game’s performance under the hood. While the dev team is working hard on 0.22.0, we are not going to remain silent. There are some topics that we have wanted to discuss for long, but due to the flow of news there was no time for this.

notes.title: Update 0.21.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/c1f9d2eeb6d348666fc5ba2fce561fbf06f112f9.jpg[/img]

Today we released an update 0.21.1 for Caliber.

The update features the Heavy Metal Battle Pass with Legendary Outfits for Jiaolong, a major operator rebalance, a new mission for the Palm Road map and a rebalance of its PvP version, partial gamepad support, bug fixes and more.

Also, we lowered the prices for the majority of items both on the website and in the game client. On Steam, Coins became cheaper as well.

You can find the complete list of changes in our patch note. See you on the battlefield!

[url=https://playcaliber.com/en/patch-notes/0-21-1/]PATCH NOTE[/url]

notes.title: The Heavy Metal Battle Pass Manual
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=AUQX-YpY8mY;full][/previewyoutube]

On September 13, we are going to release a new update 0.21.1 together with the Heavy Metal Battle Pass!

[list]
[*] Hylan Legendary Outfits for the Jiaolong collection are the main reward of the Battle Pass.
[*] Apart from the Legendary Outfits, there are a number of other rewards: Epic Outfits for Perun and Freyr, Coins, 2.480.000 Credits (for all the Episodes including the free sections), Premium, etc.
[*] The price of one Episode will be lower than it used to be — 2.500 Coins. Also, we have increased a discount for one-time purchasing two, three, and all four Episodes. You can purchase all Episodes with a 40% discount. Please note that with the release of the update Coins will become significantly less expensive on the website.
[*] For completing free sections of the Battle Pass, you will receive a new Warship HQ background, 880,000 Credits (for all Episodes), Coins, customization elements, etc.
[/list]

This is the first Battle Pass that features Legendary Outfits as the main reward. However, it doesn't mean that there will be no more Battle Passes with operators.

[url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/679/the-heavy-metal-battle-pass-manual/]Get yourself ready[/url] for completing the Battle Pass now.

notes.title: Lowering Our Prices!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/f8053af93c14d1b10fe7cecccfac79e1c7984db6.jpg[/img]

Lowering prices for all items!

With the release of the version 0.21.1, Coins will cost significantly less on the website, which means that every game item in Caliber will become more affordable too! Premium and the majority of Packs will cost less as well.

We haven't forgotten about the game client. The majority of customization items and Packs that can be purchased with in-game currencies will cost less. 

Moreover, given the new value of Credits, we will adjust the content of Special Offers that contain Credits in the game client and on the website.

You can find more details in the [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/675/lowering-our-prices/]article.
[/url]

notes.title: RE: Balance — Update 0.21.1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4y2AbEAiumI;full][/previewyoutube]

Are you ready for a rebalance? Because this time it's really big!

We have adjusted the gameplay for not just one, but two classes: Assaults and Marksmen using bolt-action rifles. While the former will be debuffed in their survivability, the latter will receive a significant buff.

Smoke grenades will become more useful and plentiful. Also, upgrades to tactical flashlights and laser sights will increase accuracy when hip-firing.

There will be a lot of other tweaks which are too many to be mentioned in a short post. So, please visit our website for more details. Please note that the article features base HP changes without mentioning upgrades and skills.

Read —  https://playcaliber.com/en/news/671/re-balance-update-0-21-1/

notes.title: Threshold Mode: Respawn Issue Fixed!
notes.content:
Good news, everyone! We have determined the cause of the respawns breaking in Threshold mode. The fixes were added to the game on July 28, but we wanted to take a short pause to ensure their success.

Just like the other cases, the identification of the cause of the error takes up the most time, compared to the fix itself. 

So, what has been going on with the respawns? Imagine that a late stage of a match is underway — the additional time starts and the respawns are turned off, so the teams can finally finish the battle. Everything seems fine, and the winner has been determined. BUT! The respawns stop working during the following matches, even for different players in different matches, from the very start of the match!

The aforementioned example is actually a method of replicating this error, but it took us quite a while to get it. It was hard to imagine that we had to look not at the affected match to find the error, but at the match BEFORE that.

In closing, remember that the New Horizons Marathon now lasts until August 16. See you at the Threshold!

notes.title: About respawn in the Threshold mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/ac7a1adc89fdbafdb256f70a312286871a8bdbd3.png[/img]

Yesterday we fixed a number of known issues that blocked respawning in Threshold mode. However, as it turns out, there are still others. Sadly, there was not enough time for our internal tests to detect all of the respawn bugs.

Major challenge to fix this — impossibility to reproduce respawning error stably.

You can play for quite a long time without any problems, and sometimes respawn errors appear regularly. Even at this moment it is difficult to understand what exactly leads to them.

Now we are trying to spot this bug by disabling various mode modules. It takes time to build a test client and tests after each such change. Unfortunately, it may take more time to resolve the issue than we expected.

We don't give up. Fix. Test. Repeat.

notes.title: How to handle misbehaving players
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/bf0344bd3f360486a9766d6c3947c68861e8b089.png[/img]

Having problems with toxic players? Cannot concentrate on the game because of shouting and foul language? Remember: you can always turn off other players' voice and report them.

Just a couple of clicks and your nerves are saved.

During a battle, press the [TAB] button, then click the button with three dots next to a player's nickname. With a pop-up menu, you can:

[olist]
[*] Click the sound icon to turn off their voice.
[*] Click the thumb down icon to report them.
[/olist]

notes.title: 0.21.0 update: patch note
notes.content:
We are launching a new marathon called New Horizons that features the updated rating system. The main reward of the marathon will be the Beluga Legendary Outfits for the GROM collection. There is a new game mode called Threshold and a new map called Polar Station as well as a number of bug fixes.

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] The New Horizons Marathon has started.
[*] Added GROM Legendary Outfits: Beluga. These can be obtained with the New Horizons marathon currency until August 16.
[*] Added the Threshold game mode.
[*] Added the Polar Station map.
[*] The Army Surplus Container objective has been made easier to complete. It now requires 3 victories per day instead of 5.
[*] Added the dynamic nav mesh for robots, drones and bots. They are now able to travel more efficiently and through previously inaccessible routes.
[*] The beta test for the User Battle game mode has begun.
[*] The matchmaking system has been improved: additional filters have been added for account levels (above and below Level 25) and team composition.
[*] Launcher settings data is now saved after reinstallation.
[*] Fore! Emote: fixed a bug that caused the golf club to clip through the operator’s model.
[*] Customization menu: fixed a bug that caused the mannequin to float in the air after finishing the execution animation.
[*] Superiority Emote: Fixed a bug that caused the emote to display incorrectly on the operator preparations screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the Armor Plate combat reserve from fully replenishing armor. The bug happened if the operator could have more than 80 AP.
[*] Improved the "Dynamic props on characters" option. You can now choose between the "Off", "Low" and "High: settings. The "High" option improves hair animations for Sly and Shersheret.
[*] Fixed a number of bugs that caused the game launcher to freeze with the "Processing request. Please wait..." message.

notes.title: Threshold Mode: rules and nuances
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/e9b816b058b6dc98357f73f4f0aac96ddc242471.jpg[/img]

The new mode, Threshold, is coming to the game on July 19!

Threshold is a PvPvE mode for two teams of 4 players and bots. The goal of each team is to destroy the enemy HQ. The battle lasts up to 40 minutes (not including additional time) or until a team launches a missile strike.

You can find the rules of the game mode in [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/611/threshold-mode-rules-and-nuances/]our article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/e8ca41dcfee0ba7738d52e076dfe41cff8383a9b.jpg[/img]

Isverden is a big yet sparsely populated country, located on the islands of the polar north where the climate is severe. It is dangerous to stray far from one’s camp — an unprepared traveler can freeze to death.

Polar Station is the first map of the new Theater of War. The map will be available in three game modes: Showdown, Annihilation, and the new Threshold mode. In Threshold, you will meet new bots from the Legion PMC.

[url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/609/isverden-archipelago-polar-station-map-and-legion-pmc/]Here’s the article[/url] with some lore, screenshots and additional information.

notes.title: Changes in the Prestige mechanics
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793126/c5f1c74e935c23320ca7600e213eee959c3ab04c.jpg[/img]

0.20.2 will be the next Caliber version. We are ready to share some details!

In this update, we are going to change the way Prestige works. The first activation and subsequent Prestige leveling up will no longer reset operators’ progress. Your operator shall retain all their upgrades. 

Activation of each Prestige level costs 420,000 Credits. It is the same as the total cost of leveling up an operator. Apart from Credits, in order to raise the Prestige level, one has to earn 120,000 XP on the chosen operator.

Also, we have changed the rewards a little. The Extra XP bonus will only be awarded upon reaching the first level of Prestige. By reaching Prestige level 5, you will acquire a unique Superiority Emote.

In [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/575/changes-in-the-prestige-mechanics/]the article, [/url]we will tell more about the changes we've made and explain why we've made them.

We would like to express our gratitude to all the players who joined Caliber on Steam in the last five days. During this period, we have been carefully monitoring the game performance both from a technical standpoint and player behavior. Also, we have been scrutinizing your comments on the Steam forums and user reviews on the store page. 

Please note that we are a relatively small team with limited resources; while it is difficult to meet all your requests in the blink of an eye, it doesn’t mean that we’re not working hard to improve the game and its performance.

[*] Working on the next big special event for Caliber – Victory Day.

notes.title: STEAM Q&A
notes.content:
[h3]I ALREADY HAVE AN ACCOUNT IN CALIBER. WILL I BE ABLE TO PLAY VIA STEAM?[/h3]
Yes.
[olist]
[*] All you have to do is download the game from Steam, launch it and log in.
[*] Next, you have to enter your login and password credentials of the account you registered on playcaliber.com.
[*] Done. Your Caliber account is now connected to your Steam account. Your progress and items are safe.
[/olist]
[previewyoutube=YjuPm2B9DJI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]IF I CREATE A NEW ACCOUNT INSTEAD OF CONNECTING AN OLD ONE, WILL I BE ABLE TO DISCONNECT THE NEW ONE AND CONNECT THE OLD ONE?[/h3]
No. After creating a new Caliber account on Steam, the new account will be forever connected to the Steam account.

Please bear in mind that account creation/connection cannot be reversed.

[h3]CAN I DISCONNECT MY CALIBER ACCOUNT FROM STEAM?[/h3]
No. If you don’t like playing via Steam, you can download the game from playcaliber. com and play the usual way.

[h3]DO I HAVE TO DOWNLOAD THE GAME FROM SCRATCH TO PLAY ON STEAM?[/h3]
Yes, to start playing on Steam you have to:
[olist]
[*] Find Caliber in the Steam store.
[*] Press «Play» on the game’s page.[/olist]

[h3]CAN I SWITCH TO STEAM LATER?[/h3]
Yes. You can still play Caliber you downloaded from our website and connect your account to Steam later.

[h3]IS CALIBER FROM THE WEBSITE ANY DIFFERENT FROM THE STEAM VERSION?[/h3]
No. The website and Steam versions of the game are the same. They will receive updates simultaneously.

[h3]WHILE PLAYING ON STEAM, WILL I BE MATCHED ONLY WITH THE PLAYERS WHO PLAY ON STEAM TOO?[/h3]
In battles, players are matched from all platforms. All players, whether they play via the launcher or Steam, will play together.

[h3]WILL STEAM’S SOCIAL SYSTEM BE INTEGRATED? FOR EXAMPLE, WILL I BE ABLE TO SEE A FRIEND WHO IS PLAYING IN SHOWDOWN?[/h3]
For now, there is no such thing in the game. In future, we will try to use all opportunities that Steam offers.

[h3]WILL THERE BE STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS?[/h3]
Yes. We are working on a significant list of achievements including the ones with hidden completion conditions.

[h3]WILL I BE ABLE TO PARTICIPATE IN THE STEAM EVENT BY PLAYING CALIBER VIA THE LAUNCHER?[/h3]
No. [url=https://playcaliber.com/en/news/510/april-12-19-steam-event/]Tasks[/url] can be completed only by playing on Steam.

[h3]WHAT WILL HAPPEN IF I ADD CALIBER TO STEAM VIA «ADD A NON-STEAM GAME TO MY LIBRARY» OPTION?[/h3]
In this case, the game will be launched via the launcher and you will not be able to enjoy the advantages the Steam launch presents.

[h3]IF I PRESS «PLAY» ON STEAM, WILL IT START THE LAUNCHER OR THE LOGIN SCREEN?
[/h3]
If you connect your Steam account to your Caliber account, you will not see the launcher or the login screen. You will be redirected to your HQ menu.

[h3]I BOUGHT AN ITEM WHILE PLAYING ON STEAM. WILL I BE ABLE TO USE IT IF I LAUNCH THE GAME VIA THE LAUNCHER?[/h3]
Yes. It’s the same account.

[h3]WILL I BE ABLE TO SEE HOW MANY HOURS I HAVE SPENT IN CALIBER IN TOTAL IF I CONNECT MY ACCOUNT TO STEAM?[/h3]
No. Steam shows the number of hours you played only on Steam.

[h3]WILL MY STEAM FRIENDS LIST BE SYNCHRONIZED WITH MY IN-GAME FRIENDS LIST?[/h3]
No.

[h3]WILL I BE ABLE TO INVITE TO MY FIRETEAM OR RECEIVE INVITES VIA STEAM?[/h3]
Yes. There will be «Invite through Steam» button in the Contacts section.
